name: Metronome Mage
lang: English, Simplified Chinese
short: Metronome Mage is a pixel-art desktop companion that turns keyboard input into mana, spells, loot, and dungeon progress. Keep the small mage on your desktop, start Pomodoro-style explorations, and make focus time feel like a light fantasy adventure.
about: Metronome Mage is a pixel-art desktop companion idle progression game. It lives in a transparent magical window above your desktop, keeping you company while you work, study, write, code, or read. Every valid keyboard input becomes character experience, mana, and adventure progress, turning everyday focus time into a light fantasy journey.    Set against a Lo-Fi music backdrop, the game features a relaxed, comforting pixel-art style with a small mage, dungeon doors, monsters, loot, spell effects, and equipment. It is not a large windowed RPG or a complex productivity app, but a quiet, cute, always-visible focus companion.     Core Gameplay     By default, your mage takes part in light idle combat. Your keyboard input builds mana, casts spells, defeats monsters, and earns gold, equipment, and collectibles.    When you are ready to begin a focus session, you can start a 15, 25, or 45 minute dungeon exploration. Each exploration lets you choose a region and an optional TODO. When the timer ends, you earn gold, loot, skill growth, regional progress, and an adventure record. Even if you end early, input experience already earned is preserved, so reading, thinking, and low-input tasks still receive steady feedback.  Exploration and combat can drop collectible spells and rare loot. Each region has its own spell pool. Once unlocked, spells can add visual effects, keyboard sounds, and effect-chain abilities. You can freely combine and reorder effects such as delay, reverb, chorus, low-pass, and noise, making keyboard feedback, Lo-Fi music, and rest ambience grow richer as your collection expands, sometimes producing unexpected sound textures.   Unique Features   - A transparent, always-on-top, draggable small window designed to sit in a desktop corner for long sessions.  - Keyboard input drives growth, but raw typed text is not saved; only statistics, experience, and adventure results are recorded.  - Pomodoro-style dungeon exploration combined with RPG rewards: regions, rooms, monsters, equipment, collectible spells, and rare loot.  - Built-in Lo-Fi music, adjustable keyboard feedback, visual effects, and focus presets.  - TODOs, weekly goals, achievements, character bonds, and statistics panels help make long-term effort visible.     Use It To Supports Focus     Metronome Mage turns ordinary focus time into visible progress. It does not force you to fill out complex forms or interrupt your workflow with punishments. Choose a goal, begin an exploration, and return to the real task. The code you write, documents you finish, notes you review, and reading you keep up with all leave traces of growth on your desktop mage.    It is designed for players who want to reduce the friction of starting, maintain a steady focus rhythm, and enjoy pixel RPGs, desktop pets, and lightweight progression feedback.     Privacy Statement     This software does not upload player data. Keyboard input is used only for in-game experience, mana, statistics, and adventure feedback. Raw typed text is not stored and is not used for any purpose outside the entertainment functions of the game itself.

name: There's a Cat in My PC
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Russian, Vietnamese, Swedish, Arabic, Indonesian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Thai, Turkish, Portuguese - Brazil, Polish, Korean
short: A completely free desktop companion pet with no payments, ever! Allergic to cats? You can still adopt! Meet 98 one-of-a-kind cats that drop by every day, right on top of your PC windows, keeping you company without ever getting in the way~
about: 100% Free — A Cat Living Inside Your Computer    Cats show up anywhere on your Windows desktop. They walk along the top edges of your open windows, leap from window to window, and take naps. You can grab them with your mouse to carry them around, or give them a toss. They never steal focus from whatever you're working on, and clicks only register on the cat's own pixels — so they stay out of your way while you type. It's a desktop companion — it keeps you company while you do other things.     ■ One free draw, every day           Once a day, open "Today's Parcel" to find 3 cats and 2 bundles of Churu inside. There's no payment option anywhere. It's once a day, so don't forget to open it every day~ (The daily draw is only available while connected to the internet)     ■ Catnip that grows while you play — a bonus draw   Keep the game running and catnip grows: one for every 20 hours of play, up to 3 at a time. Shake some catnip and cats come visiting for another draw — again 3 cats and 2 bundles of Churu! (Catnip grows only while Steam is running, and shaking it requires an internet connection)     ■ 98 diverse cats, each with a different personality        98 cats of every color and pattern are waiting for you, each with its own personality and way of speaking. Now and then they talk to themselves — what they say depends on their personality and the time of day: morning, noon, evening or night. Click a cat and it'll say something to you.     ■ Name them — and read today's fortune!           Give each of your cats a name of your own. Enter your birth date to get today's fortune card, with readings for money, people, work & study, and health. Fortunes come from data built into the game, so no internet connection is needed, and a new one arrives when the date changes.     ■ A home, furniture, and relaxing~        Set up a cat house and your cats will rest inside and wander out on their own. You can place furniture like a cat tower, and since furniture wears down over time, you'll need to use Churu to repair it. Of course, they'll still run around on your windows too.     ■ A lightweight companion   A desktop pet needs to stay running all day. We kept CPU and memory usage to a minimum. Even without an internet connection, your cats behave normally.

about: This is a story you create together with a girl named "Lyra" on the other side of the screen.  A chat app you've never seen before appears on your computer. The moment you open it, a girl in strange work clothes asks for your help.  Talk through the chat app, open web pages to dig for clues, read between the lines, and piece together the full picture of the world across from you. Gameplay     The game simulates a desktop chat app called "Pin!". Inside Pin!, you'll receive a plea for help from a girl named Lyra.    She doesn't seem like just another friend on the other side of Earth. You don't have to solve that mystery right away—right now, Lyra is caught in a natural disaster and can't save herself. She needs your help!    Search the web of the world across from you, find clues, and help Lyra escape her current crisis!    Pin! can shrink into a discreet floating widget that sits quietly on your desktop. When a new message arrives, a little red dot will tip you off.    Every chat and image is saved—you can flip back through the full message history anytime.    After the main story ends, you can still share many new everyday chats and interactions with Lyra. She'll keep you company on the desktop as that little chat window.

about: Experience the Ultimate Desktop Creature Auto-Battler           Welcome to the  Ium Idle Companions Odyssey  demo!  This playable demo gives you a generous, feature-complete slice of the game, letting you experience the core loop of recruiting wild creatures, fine-tuning team builds, and battling through the first  three full regions —all while your squad runs unobtrusively at the bottom or corner of your screen as a lightweight desktop companion.  Whether you let your team farm resources while you work, study, or browse, or dive into full-window mode on your monitor or Steam Deck, this demo showcases the deep strategic freedom and charming retro pixel action of  Ium Idle Companions Odyssey .           What’s Included in This Demo      The First 3 Complete Regions (Tier 1):      The Sunken Ruins:  Ancient stone pathways crawling with wild starters and airborne threats.     The Murky Swamp:  Toxic bayous teeming with aquatic amphibians, poisonous insects, and venomous hazards.     The Scorched Badlands:  Blistering desert dunes and ancient tombs protected by fiery fiends and undead sentinels.    Fight through  30 handcrafted stages  leading up to climactic MidBoss encounters and colossal Region Bosses.       Dozens of Recruitable Iums:     Choose your starter companion from three distinct archetypes (close-range melee power, ranged tank, or toxic burst).    Encounter, defeat, and recruit dozens of wild Ium species across multiple Families (Beasts, Avians, Constructs, Amorphous, Undead, and Fiends).       Full Build Customization:      Level Point (LP) Investment:  Freely allocate earned LP across six core attributes to mold each Ium into your desired role.     Portable Skills & Loadouts:  Unlock, equip, and swap active basic attacks, projectiles, area strikes, and healing spells.     Gear & Artifacts:  Equip and test gear combinations that alter attack speed, skill geometry, and defensive stats.     AI Combat Directives:  Tailor how each companion fights—assign them to  Aggressive ,  Cautious ,  Supportive , or  Natural  behaviors.       10 Elemental Types & Party Resonance:     Exploit elemental strengths and vulnerabilities across Fire, Water, Ice, Earth, Storm, Nature, Poison, Dark, Arcane, and Neutral.    Pair Iums of matching elements to unlock squad-wide  Party Resonance  passives.       Full Desktop Companion Mode:     Enjoy the complete companion experience! Pin the transparent, compact overlay to the edge of your desktop so your squad fights alongside your daily tasks with zero intrusion.    Seamlessly toggle to normal windowed/fullscreen mode whenever you want dedicated play sessions.         What’s Coming in the Full Game   Enjoyed the demo? name: 喵呜风云
lang: Simplified Chinese*, English*, Japanese**
short: Hang a battlefield on your desktop and let your soldier fight and grow automatically. Plan talents, buy gear, refine builds, and use APM to boost combat speed. Team up with friends for ranked battles, chase higher KDA and scores, and find out who is best at “strategic slacking” during work.
about: Welcome to  Meow Field : a tiny battlefield you can keep running right on your desktop! There are no controls so complicated that you’ll feel like writing a thesis, but it’s not the kind of idle game where you simply walk away and forget it exists, either. Your character will charge, shoot, reload, and throw grenades on their own. Your job is to plan their growth path, then occasionally tap the keyboard or click the mouse to remind them that, yes, they can absolutely work harder.    喵(>^ω^<)——————————————————◐⩊◑  ྀི——————————————————(>^ω^<)喵           The game blends idle progression, auto-battling, and incremental growth. You’ll repeatedly clear stages to earn gold and experience, then use the Gold Shop to unlock new firearms, equipment, and vehicles. As you progress, you’ll gain access to more weapon attachments and equipment items, opening up increasingly varied character builds. Battles can also reward you with a variety of chests, which you can open to obtain all kinds of weapons and equipment!                      Four soldier classes each have their own roles and strengths. Every class has an independent talent tree, and you can keep strengthening them through levels, talents, Gold Shop upgrades, and equipment combinations. More classes and talents are also planned for future updates!    ꒰ᐢ๑＞ᴥ＜๑ᐢ꒱——————————————————◤•͈ᴥ•͈◥ ୭——————————————————꒰ᐢ๑＞ᴥ＜๑ᐢ꒱          In addition to solo idle progression, you can team up with friends online to enter battles together, push through stages, and earn resources as a squad. When teammates are offline, mirror data can continue joining the fight, so your desktop squad doesn’t have to suffer from the classic “not enough people, call it off” problem. Multiplayer teams offer higher combat efficiency and more room to experiment with class synergies.    喵(>^ω^<)——————————————————◐⩊◑  ྀི——————————————————(>^ω^<)喵          The game will also feature ranked battles. Bring your trained classes, weapons, equipment, and builds into more challenging combat, then test them against other players’ lineups or mirror data. Ranked battles focus on long-term growth, power-building, and strategic combinations, giving your idle progression a clearer goal beyond simply making the numbers bigger.    ꒰ᐢ๑＞ᴥ＜๑ᐢ꒱——————————————————◤•͈ᴥ•͈◥ ୭——————————————————꒰ᐢ๑＞ᴥ＜๑ᐢ꒱          The APM system tracks your inputs and converts them into short bursts of action acceleration. In simple terms, your clicks and key presses are not wasted. They help your soldier move faster, attack more often, and reload more smoothly. Idle players can grow at their own pace, while active players can hammer the battlefield rhythm into something delightfully frantic. Of course, the hardest workers will always be more efficient.  This is a game designed for long-term growth at the edge of your desktop: clear stages, earn money, level up, unlock gear, refine builds, team up with friends, test your setup in ranked battles, and watch those battlefield numbers get prettier and prettier.

name: Late Night Tavern
lang: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean
short: Late Night Tavern is an idle management game where you run Hizuki, a late-night bar, with its vampire owner. Arrange furniture, mix and match outfits and create new dishes. As your bar grows popular, you'll uncover a secret conspiracy hidden behind the mysterious monsters known as yokai.
about: Late Night Tavern is a pixel-art idle management game that sits on your desktop. No complicated controls: run your bar and collect recipes and outfits while you work or watch videos on your PC. No grinding, no leveling pressure.    ★ A Beginning Without Memories, and the Mysterious Yokai ★  One stormy night, hunted by mysterious monsters called yokai, you lose your memory and collapse in an alley of Tokyo's Golden Gai. Luckily, Sayaka Inoue, a vampire and the owner of a little bar called Hizuki, carries you back there and looks after you.    You don't know where you came from. All you remember is your name. And so you start tending bar with Sayaka and her bartender, Hana Kurosawa. Between shifts, you slowly piece together your own past, and where the mysterious yokai really come from.    ★ Characters ★          ★ 180+ Pieces of Furniture and 266 Dishes: Run a Bar All Your Own ★  Classic wooden bar, Japanese izakaya, night sakura... The more care you put into the décor, the more your customers are willing to spend. Bar counters, sofas, a piano, a tatami kotatsu, a retro jukebox, and neon signs, ukiyo-e prints and hanging scrolls for the walls. Hizuki's style is yours to decide!    Dispatch your companions to defeat yokai, gather ingredients and research new recipes: 266 cocktails, dishes and desserts are waiting to be discovered! Recipes come in five rarities from N to UR, and the rarer the recipe, the more dazzling the moment you perfect it.            ★ 340 Outfit Pieces, 6 Slots to Mix and Match: Dress Your Character Your Way ★  Hats, face, tops, gloves, bottoms and shoes: outfits span six slots you can swap freely to match your style. With 16 hairstyles × 12 hair colors, 8 eye shapes × 8 eye colors and 6 skin tones, create the character who will grow and adventure alongside you!            ★ Night Gifts and Eclipse Treasures: Random Limited Rewards ★  While you play online on Steam, the Night Post will call you from time to time. Pick up, and you'll receive limited outfits, furniture, pets or recipe cards. The rare pets Mameshiba, Foxfire and Mochi each come in three colors: Original, Moonlit and Night-hued.    Each time the number of active tavern keepers reaches a milestone, a collectible that is issued only once, with every copy individually numbered, is sent out to keepers chosen from among the active players!         ★ More Features ★    Take on 66 kinds of urban legends and yokai across 12 Tokyo districts, including Shinjuku, Shibuya, Akihabara and Asakusa, and collect their rare Shiny variants.    When you're online, the view outside the window follows the live weather in your city with rain, snow and thunder, and the moon stays in sync with the real lunar phase.    The jukebox holds 11 lofi tracks, and rain and thunder have their own volume sliders, keeping you company while you chill, work or just hang out at your PC.    A 10-chapter main story and 60+ events slowly unravel the secrets of Hizuki and Tokyo's nights.    Events branch into different choices, and every dish you serve can change how the story unfolds.

name: Task Bar Maid Cafe
lang: English, Russian, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Vietnamese, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Japanese
short: A cozy café. A hungry party RPG. Build a crew of five maids, feed demanding guests and face enormous appetites — all in a strip above your taskbar. Level up, equip your team, upgrade the kitchen and come home to your own café.
about: Feed them before they rage. Task Bar Maid Cafe runs in a slim strip right above your taskbar. Guests walk in, sit down and get hungry — and your maids deal with them while you work, study or browse. It looks like a cosy café. It plays like a party RPG.         Pick your favourite. Build your crew.    Marie  — A sunny smile and nerves of steel. Marie rolls in with her dessert trolley and takes the complaints so the others can keep serving.   Gina  — A wicked grin. A tray full of trouble. Gina brings the big portions — and the confidence to match.   Luisa  — Sharp tongue. Precise delivery. Luisa sends drinks across the café without losing her sarcastic composure.   Fiona  — Shy doesn't mean helpless. Fiona keeps the crew on their feet with coffee, one quiet rescue at a time.   Nekko  — That smug smile says she already owns the room. Nekko helps wherever she's needed — and brings a song to the café.  Pick your shift team before the doors open. A café that works like a dungeon   Every guest has a hunger bar. Every dish you serve takes a bite out of it.   A hungry guest complains — and complaints drain your maids' energy.   Run out of energy and a maid has to sit down. If everyone sits down, the shift is lost.   At the end of each map's tenth shift, a very hungry boss arrives.   Level up. Gear up. Dress up.      Gain levels, spend stat points and equip eight gear slots — tools of the trade, headpieces, uniforms, stockings, shoes, rings and pendants — in five rarities, from common to mythic. Upgrade what you like and sell what you don't.  Equipment changes your build. Not every item has its own visual outfit. A better kitchen. A stronger crew.      Invest your gold in 16 permanent upgrades across hot food, sweets, coffee and service. Unlock a signature omelette, shorten cooking times and prepare your kitchen for the next shift. After the rush, come home.      Step behind the counter in HOME. See guests chatting over coffee and the maids who are not on a mission working in your café. Try different interior themes in the current prototype. Three cafés, thirty shifts, three very hungry bosses         Start in Akihabara, then open cafés by the beach and in the mountains. Elite guests turn up halfway through each map; the Great Gourmet, the Barbecue King and the Fondue Baron wait at the end. Made for the edge of your screen   Lives in a strip above the taskbar and keeps running while you do something else.   Skills on auto or by hand, speed x1 / x2 / x4.   16 interface languages are planned for release.    Make room for your next favourite café. Add Task Bar Maid Cafe to your wishlist and let Steam tell you when the doors open.    The game is in development. Screenshots show the current build and will be updated.

name: Just Bouncing
lang: English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Japanese
short: It bounces. That's all. There is only one thing to do — wait for the moment it lands exactly in the corner.
about: This bounces.  JustBouncing takes an image you choose and bounces it across your desktop, forever.  It does nothing more than that. It does nothing less than that.  It bounces. Forever.  For that one moment.  You remember it. The legendary bouncing logo of the 90s, gliding across a standby screen, and one breathless question: "Will it land exactly in the corner this time?" Live that feeling, one more time.  When the logo finally hits the corner perfectly, it bursts into rainbow color, confetti rains from both sides, and  you are filled with the most satisfying feeling in the world.  It will never interrupt your work.  The bouncing logo is rendered as a click-through transparent overlay. Your boss will never know it is there. Your browser, editor, and meeting apps all work normally right through it.  You glance at the corner of your screen. It's there. That's all you need. Features (there really are this many)    Use any image — drop in your own PNG, JPG, or animated GIF    Clean transparent edges    Full multi-monitor support — bounces correctly even on L-shaped layouts    8-color cycling — color changes on every wall hit    Special corner-hit celebration — rainbow effects    Tweak opacity, target FPS, mirror flip, color cycling — all yours    Retro classic UI — menus committed fully to the 90s    Languages: 日本語 / English / 简体中文 / 繁體中文   Steam Features     "Corner Hits" Leaderboard  — global ranking of all-time corner hits (compete proudly against idle people from around the world)     Rich Presence  — flex your corner-hit count to your friends     Steam Cloud  — your settings and stats follow you to any PC   Recommended for    Anyone who actually held their breath waiting for a corner hit    Anyone who needs something quietly moving in the corner of their screen    Anyone with a weakness for retro-looking software    Anyone willing to pay for the right to wait

about: A little corner of your screen. A dungeon full of secrets.  MIMIC HUNGER is an idle desktop game about raising a hungry little Mimic. Keep an eye on its adventure while you work or watch videos, turn loot into strength, and uncover the secrets buried deep underground.  Your next chest could hold a miracle.         Discover over 300 items across 8 rarity tiers, each with its own dazzling reveal. Enjoy the anticipation of opening a chest—and the thrill of finding something extraordinary. Even enemies on the very first floor can drop the highest rarity. The odds? One in two million. Can you beat the odds and claim a miraculous find?  Raise it. Dress it up. Make it yours.         Raise familiars, earn achievements, collect titles and outfits, and compete in online rankings. There is plenty to pursue beyond your next chest. Build your own Mimic and aim to become the ultimate Mimic King!  Deeper floors. Greater treasures. Stronger foes.         The deeper you descend, the richer the loot and the tougher the enemies. Strengthen your Mimic, challenge new floors, and discover treasures you have never seen before.  Follow a mysterious voice to the 50th floor.  Elna is a mysterious presence known only by her voice. Can your Mimic reach her on the 50th floor underground? And what awaits beyond? Conquer floor 50, then venture even deeper. Something no one has discovered yet lies beneath.  An adventure at home on your desktop.  Watch the adventure unfold in the corner of your screen in Normal Mode, or keep your Mimic close in Pet Mode. Switch between two ways to enjoy your desktop companion.  Make your hoard your own.         Display your favorite finds in your treasury and enjoy your own growing collection.

name: 方寸海洋物语
lang: Simplified Chinese
short: 《方寸海洋物语》是一款极致追求画面观赏质感，力求还原真实海缸生态的模拟养鱼游戏。工作时它安静地待在屏幕一角，陪你敲代码、写文档；学习累了，抬头看看游动的小鱼，为自己换一口气；你也可以坐在客厅沙发上欣赏这仅属于你的海洋。点点鼠标即可轻松养护，看小丑鱼钻进海葵，繁育各种珍奇鱼种，你的薄荷仙在等你。
about: 想在办公学习间隙养一缸小鱼陪伴，又怕换水喂食麻烦？  《方寸海洋物语》来了。  我们是一群爱摸鱼的佛系养鱼人——爱摸鱼，爱养鱼，也爱生活。于是，我们真实模拟了一片海洋生态，把一整片海，悄悄塞进你的屏幕。没有复杂的操作，也不用费心打理。  你可以把鱼缸贴在桌面的任意角落，它可以安静地待在文档旁边，等你累了，抬头就能看到鱼群在水草间游过。鼠标轻轻一点，鱼儿就会凑过来跟着你的光标嬉戏。也许忙碌的生活中，我们就需要这一点空闲，不是吗？  我们准备了上百种鱼和造景任你挑选，调一调灯光，换一换光影，森系的温柔、赛博的霓虹通通拥有。  这片海也不止好看。你还可以让鱼儿配对繁育，慢慢培养出独特的变异品种；卖掉养大的鱼，攒下财富，一点一点经营你的海缸。  我们希望你的电子海缸，可以变成任何你想要的样子。     每一帧都像真的鱼缸。高清拟真渲染，水波光影、珊瑚摆动、鱼鳞反光……我们希望你凑近屏幕的时候，能听见到缸中轻微的气泡声。             与淡水鱼截然不同的鲜艳海鱼，是你决心下海的原因吗？  那些因为种种原因无法收入缸中的珍稀品种，在这里，你都有机会获得——从色彩绚丽的皇后神仙、樱花宝石，到现实中贵到离谱的薄荷仙，再到大部分设备都很难养定的黑鳍鲨，都不再遥不可及。满足每个下海人心中的那份收集梦！  你可以养一群不一样的鱼             你还可以养一群一样的鱼             这是你的薄荷仙嘛？             你有没有想过自己经营一个海缸小店，繁育小鱼？  没有强制目标，佛系或野心，都由你。鼠标点点，操作直观，成就感从第一条鱼苗开始。             你可以从一条最便宜的普通鱼苗开始，低价购入，照顾它们慢慢长大，再卖出。             挑选品相好的鱼配对繁殖，说不定下一秒就会基因突变——普通蓝吊可能变成通体金色的稀有款，身价直接翻上百倍！             你的海缸想要怎么装扮？  在这里你可以切换暖光、冷光或者RGB氛围光，深海光谱自由调节，全部满足，再也不担心偏色海缸不出片！             这里还有超百种鱼种和造景素材随心拖拽搭配，无论赛博霓虹还是自然生态风格都手拿把掐！             动动手指就能搞定换水、养水，现实里稍不留神就死一缸的烦恼，在这里彻底告别！碎片时间里点几下鼠标，该有的养护程序一个不少，成就感不打折扣！             想要合法摸鱼不被“重点关注”？鱼缸可自由缩放、调节透明度与角度，完美融入桌面场景。再也不用到处调角度出片了，3D海缸支持自由旋转缩放，让你可以从任意角度全视角欣赏你的动态海缸。               把大海藏进桌面，把治愈留在身边。在《方寸海洋物语》，治愈你每一个疲惫瞬间。        加入我们：   官方QQ群：1057313511  期待你的到来，和我们一起摸鱼、养鱼~你的每一条反馈与建议，都会让这片海变得更美好！

name: Pocket Adventurer
lang: English
short: Your desktop's tiniest hero. A cozy idle RPG that lives above your taskbar: heroes delve dungeons and haul loot home while you work, companions fill your camp, and every retired legend makes the next hero stronger.
about: A cozy idle RPG that lives above your taskbar.  Pocket Adventurer sets up camp at the bottom of your screen: a tiny, always-on-top strip that shares your desktop instead of taking it over. Click into camp to check in, or leave it running while you work, study, or do literally anything else. Your hero trains, delves, and loots without you.    Send your hero into the dungeon  Auto-combat runs through hand-designed dungeons, each with its own monster families, environments, and a boss at the end. Loot piles up, your hero levels, and the deeper you go, the stranger the world gets.       Build a camp, not just a character  Recruit companions who join your hero in camp and in the dungeon. Train at the Training Ground and grow a small roster of heroes over time. Not just one build, a whole cast.         Retire your heroes into legend  When a hero's run is done, retire them into the Hall of Heroes, where their statue keeps giving back: a small passive buff that grows as the statue's tier rises. Every hero you have ever run becomes part of what makes the next one stronger.    No servers. No season pass. No login. Yours forever.  Pocket Adventurer is a single-player game that lives on your machine. Nothing to log into, nothing that stops working if a server goes dark, nothing designed to pressure you back in. Play it for five minutes between meetings or leave it running all day. It is built to survive both.     A cozy idle RPG for your desktop.

name: Dive Log: A Focus Voyage
lang: English, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
short: Dive Log is an idle treasure-hunting game driven by a pomodoro timer: every stretch of focus becomes a deep-sea voyage. Collect treasures, upgrade your submarine and hunt the relic hidden in each sea. Play your own music and ambience, and design the sea's treasures to share with other captains.
about: Sit down, put your headphones on, and let a submarine keep you company while you focus.   Dive Log: A Focus Voyage is an idle treasure-hunting game built around a focus timer. Pick the timing mode that suits you, hit Set Sail, then get on with the work in front of you.  Your submarine dives while you focus, and comes back from every session with a hold full of treasure.    Pick your timer  Four timing modes: Focus Sessions (the classic pomodoro cycle), Deep Focus, Stopwatch and Custom Time. Focus and break lengths are yours to set, so each run fits the state you're in.    Tools for the working day  A to-do list, quick notes, a voyage diary and an alarm are all built in. Keep track of what you're working on, catch an idea the moment it lands, and write down how the day went to read back later. Your submarine's own progress is recorded alongside it.    Focus and grow  While you focus, your submarine trawls the depths and hauls in treasures and materials. Once a voyage ends, spend what it brought back on upgrades and new seas, and fill your codex with over two hundred treasures.    Make the sea your own  Music and ambience (rain, sea, campfire and more white-noise-style sounds) are included, and you can load in your own audio files. Even the alarm sound can be swapped out.  The treasures in the sea can be your own work too. The built-in treasure editor takes you from uploading an image to a finished piece without leaving the game or touching a single file, and you can publish straight to the Steam Workshop. Subscribe to what other captains have made and their treasures join your sea.    KEY FEATURES  ・Four timing modes: Focus Sessions, Deep Focus (focus blocks run back to back, breaks saved for the end), Stopwatch and Custom Time, plus plenty of options for tuning the cycle.  ・While you focus on real work, your submarine explores the seafloor and picks up treasures and materials along the way.  ・Spend what your submarine brings back on part upgrades and fresh paint, and open up five seas, each with its own story and treasures.  ・Collect over two hundred treasures and fill up the codex. Every sea hides a relic of its own!  ・49 achievements covering focus hours, submarine progress and collecting. The counters keep climbing after you unlock them, so the work you put in still gets recorded.  ・Open the diary any time to see each day's focus time and submarine progress, with weekly and monthly totals put together for you.  ・The sky and the weather follow the real time of day, or you can pin the light to morning, noon, dusk or night.  ・Custom audio files: music, ambience and the alarm sound can all be swapped for your own.  ・Treasure editor: upload an image, write the description, and design a treasure of your own inside the game. No coding required.  ・Steam Workshop: publish your treasure packs without leaving the game, and subscribe to what other players have made.  ・Mini Mode: shrink the window into a corner of your desktop and keep the timer, your to-do list and your submarine in view.  ・Steam Cloud saves supported.     In everyday life, finishing something rarely gives much back right away.   That's the gap Dive Log fills: the time you spend concentrating turns into a voyage and a hold full of treasure.

name: Tame-a-goat-chi Demo
lang: English*, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Portugal, Simplified Chinese*
short: A cozy goat companion world that lives at the edge of your screen. Care for a herd of unique, lovable goats, each with their own personality, and watch while you work, study, or relax.
about: Tame-a-goat-chi is a cozy world of goats that live alongside your daily routine, gently unfolding at the bottom of your screen.       You start with a small pasture and a few lovable goats, each with their own personality and moods. As you go about your day, they wander, play, and react to the world around them, turning your farm into a living, evolving space.  Caring for your goats keeps them happy. Happy goats become more active and playful, and over time they generate coins that help your farm grow.        Every Goat is Unique         No two goats behave the same way.  Each goat has its own personality, preferences, and emotional rhythm. Some are calm and affectionate, others are chaotic and energetic, and all of them react differently to toys, food, music, and attention. The more you care for them, the more their personality unfolds.        Build Your Living Pasture        Taking care of your goats generates coins over time. These coins let you expand your farm, unlock new goats, and improve your overall experience. You can also hire helpers who assist with caring for your herd and automating daily tasks.  You can grow crops, place interactive objects, and unlock new goat breeds with unique traits. The pasture becomes a small ecosystem where goats, objects, and environment constantly interact in surprising ways.        Mini Games and Magic Events        Life in the pasture is full of surprises.  Your goats can take part in playful mini games and lighthearted challenges. Unexpected events can also occur, such as a goat DJ leading a dance party, or more sudden and chaotic surprises like Goatzilla arriving on the farm.        Designed for Daily Life        The pasture lives quietly at the bottom of your screen while you work, study, or relax.  You can check in anytime to care for your goats, collect coins, and watch your farm evolve naturally throughout the day.    Key Features   • Cozy Lower-Half Screen Pasture: A calm goat world that becomes part of your everyday  screen space  • Unique Goat Personalities: Every goat behaves in its own unique way  • Care & Rewards Loop: Care for goats to earn coins and grow your farm  • Mini Games & Challenges: Goats take part in fun, lighthearted activities  • Joyful Surprise Events: Unexpected moments that bring chaos and joy  • Evolving Goat Farm: Expand with goats, toys, objects, and helpers

about: 'Boing Boing Animals'  is a virtual pet-raising game inspired by Tamagotchi.    You are entrusted with a special mission: caring for slimes that have drifted to Earth from distant outer space. With your loving attention, they can grow into one of over 200 different Earth animals. Each one retains the slime's signature 'Boing Boing' movements, making them delightfully unique companions.  Go beyond simple pet care—build a genuine bond through affection and welcome them as your true virtual companions. No matter what you're doing, these small and lovable pixel friends will always stay by your side.     Meet a variety of animals   Dogs, cats, rabbits, hamsters, birds, dinosaurs... and even legendary creatures! Their appearance changes depending on what you feed them, as well as the weather and time of day during their growth. Enjoy watching each animal's unique and adorable behaviors.           Care for them with love   Feed them, wash them, play together, and enjoy mini-games. The more love you give, the more they will open their hearts and show affection in return.           A one-of-a-kind companion   Every slime has its own personality, gender, and preferences. Some may even have special abilities, like talking or singing. Others might stay awake with you late into the night! Who will you meet?        Meet even more friends   Use resources earned from caring for slimes to buy items and unlock the mansion, expanding your space to raise more slimes. Decorate each space with different themes and create your own cozy slime home.                   Decorate your way   Customize your slime's living space. Change colors, add stickers, and set backgrounds. Save your favorite designs as presets and switch between them easily.        Always together, no need to say goodbye   You may choose to send an adult slime back to its home planet, but it's entirely optional. Slimes never die, so you can stay together for as long as you wish.       Key Features     Over 200 pixel animals with unique animations    Cute and charming pixel art style    Real-time day/night cycle and weather effects    Extensive customization with UI color editing and dozens of decorative items    Collection features including Codex entries and achievements    Various mini-games to enjoy with your slimes       Enjoy relaxing moments with your adorable pixel friends on your desktop!

name: Bowls Above
lang: English, Simplified Chinese
short: Bowls Above is an always-on-top corporate satire idle sim powered by working programs. Work makes tokens rain; tokens hit workers; workers lose bowls. Grow your workforce and build a wild pin-machine.
about: NO AGENT WORKING, NO Tokens.     Need something to play with while waiting the slow AI agents?  Bowls Above is an always-on-top idle  sim powered by the work you were already doing. Choose an AI coding agent—or another program—and watch that activity become a steady rain of pachinko balls.     The tokens ricochet through the cabinet, finish worker assignments, and knock loose the bowls that drive the company. Your machine works while you work. When you stop, it waits.             A TINY COMPANY ABOVE YOUR DESKTOP    Run Bowls Above as a transparent, draggable desktop companion beside your code. It can detect Claude Code, Codex, a custom running app.     Detection happens locally. Your code, prompts, filenames, and program names are not uploaded.   CLIMB THE VERY NORMAL CORPORATE LADDER    Tokens hit workers. Workers drop bowls. Bowls permanently fill your next PERK. Sounds familiar?    Hire new employees, promote them and turn them into company gears.         TURN THE BOARD INTO A MACHINE    Drag Gears onto pins. Combine matching Gears to level them up. Build strange, satisfying machine.    Each tracked program keeps its own workforce, board, Gears, PERKS, milestones, and stats. Switching tools feels like opening another branch office.    BUILD MOMENTUM. BRIEFLY BECOME EFFICIENT.      Play passively while you work, or check in to resolve banked PERKS, arrange Gears, combine upgrades.      Work-powered pachinko — activity makes the tokens; real money never does.     Always-on-top desktop companion — transparent, draggable, resizable, and built to live beside your work.    Persistent  progression — workers, ranks, bowls, PERKS, Policies, Buffs, milestones, and Gears.    Per-program companies — keep separate branches for different agents or apps.             Clock in. Set the machine beside your work. Try not to ask where all the bowls are going.

name: Touch Grass, Pls!
lang: English
short: Finally, touch grass. Comb a hill of grass with your mouse, pick flowers, catch fireflies and wait for rare visitors, from a frog to a dragon at night. Or make the hill your live desktop wallpaper. Free, relaxing and impressively unproductive. The grass can wait.
about: A little patch of outdoors, right at your desk  Everyone keeps telling you to touch grass. Fine. Touch Grass, Pls! is a free, single-player hill of grass that follows your mouse. Your hand combs the blades aside, and they sway and spring back behind it. Hold the button for a wider trail, or just sit with the breeze.          Wait for rare visitors          Now and then, something comes to the hill: a green frog, a honeybee, a warbler, a white egret, or a cricket at dusk. Far more rarely, a golden frog, a flamingo, or forest spirits glowing under the trees at night. And if you're very patient, a dragon glides across the night sky, or a phoenix by day. Catch the small ones and let them go; touch the big ones as they pass. The field guide keeps every creature you've met. The rest stay a mystery.  Your hill, your weather            Two hills, both free: The Meadow Hill, and Classic Wallpaper, a bright green hill under a deep blue sky, like a desktop picture you may remember.    Morning, Daytime, Sunset or Night, or Auto to follow your clock.    Soft, light or heavy rain, with thunder far off in the heavy rain.    Click the trees to change them: pine, oak or birch, alone or in a cluster.    Pick flowers, catch butterflies and fireflies, and sneak up on grasshoppers.    78 nature sounds: rain and thunderstorms, woodland and summer nights, beach waves and crackling fires. Loop one, shuffle them or search. No music, so you can play your own.    Your hill as a live wallpaper          Put the hill behind your desktop icons (Windows 10 and 11). Your mouse still touches the grass, and rare creatures still drop by. It pauses on its own behind maximized and full-screen windows, games, the lock screen and on battery. It runs at 30 FPS, lives in the tray, can start with Windows, and reads only your mouse, never what you type.  Become impressively qualified at doing very little          Touching grass earns Sunshine Essence, levels and 16 titles, from Indoor Kid to Grass Ascended.    100 Steam achievements. None needs a DLC, none can be missed, and nothing is lost if you stay away for days.    19 rewards: hand skins, golden grass tips, a butterfly that follows your hand, shooting stars, an aurora, sky lanterns, a Lucky Toad statue, a plastic flamingo and more. Each one can be switched off.    Made to be left open     Focus timer:  25 + 5, 50 + 10 or your own minutes. When focus ends: "Time to touch some real grass."     Stream mode:  hides the interface, adds a small caption and sends extra rare creatures for your chat to spot. They're only for viewing and earn nothing.     Safe to stream:  every sound is licensed, with no Content ID claims.     Light on your PC:  60 FPS by default, 30 behind other windows, 5 when minimized. Graphics from Low to Ultra, and 100,000 to 450,000 blades of grass.    Steam Cloud saves. No ads, no pop-ups.    Still a small game at heart: a hill, a mouse and a little time to unwind.  More hills (optional DLC)          Everything above is free. To support the game, two DLC add more hills and sounds:     Grass Supporter:  Pampas Hill, Golden Pampas Hill and Dandelion Hill, whose seeds fly off as you brush through, with 13 nature sounds.     Scent of Grass:  Lavender, Tulip, Wheat and Poppy, Poppy and Nemophila Hills, and Rice Terraces - Mu Cang Chai from Viet Nam, with 25 nature sounds.    On their hills of flowers, a walking house strolls by now and then. Every achievement can still be earned without them.

about: 🥚 HATCH YOUR OWN SLIME  An egg drops into your little device. Tap it, toss it around and watch it hatch into a wobbly slime, then give it a name. PocoDoro sits right on your desktop, so your pet is always close by.    🤏 POKE IT, SQUISH IT, THROW IT  Your slime is a real soft-body creature. Poke it and it squishes and smiles. Grab it and it stretches. Throw it and it splats against the walls, leaving a trail of goo, then bounces right back. Raise your slime really well and a shiny gem might turn up too.    ⏳ A LIFE IN REAL TIME  Your slime ages in real time and keeps living while you're away. It gets hungry, sleeps on a real bedtime schedule and calls for you when it needs something. How you raise it shapes how it grows up and how long it lives, and neglect has consequences. When its life ends, it leaves something behind, and a new egg begins in the same room.          📸 MEMORIES THAT STAY  Freeze any moment, move the camera around and take a photo. Pin your favourites to the wall of the room and earn permanent trophies for raising a pet well. name: Desktop Havoc
lang: English
short: Desktop Havoc turns your real Windows desktop into a chaotic physics playground. Grab an arsenal of over-the-top weapons and blast your actual windows across the screen, then dive into Battle and Zombie modes. A cartoony sandbox shooter that wrecks your desktop, not your files.
about: Your desktop is the battlefield.           Desktop Havoc is a chaotic physics sandbox that plays out on your actual Windows desktop. Pick up a ridiculous arsenal and send your real windows flying, shattering, and burning across the screen — then press Restore and put everything back. Destruction without the consequences.  Wreck your real desktop  Chaos mode runs live on your desktop. Your browser, your editor, your calculator — all fair game. Blast them, shove them, torch them. When you need to actually work, switch Chaos off and your windows stay put.  An absurd arsenal  Rockets that send windows flying across the screen. Flamethrowers, railguns, scatter shots, freeze rays, paint guns and more. Aim in 2D, or drop into first-person view to place every shot exactly where you want it. Grapple onto a window and reel yourself up to it.  Four ways to play:     💥 Chaos  — The sandbox. Rifle, scatter, grenades, rockets, a flamethrower, a freeze ray, a railgun, plasma, a grapple, and more. Shove your real windows around, crack the glass, leave scorch marks, and rack up a combo score. Opt-in — flip  Chaos: Off  and shots just wobble windows harmlessly.     ⚔️ Battle  — 1v1 against an enemy that actually plays smart: it feints, edge-guards, adapts to your habits, and fights across four distinct personalities. Ring it out to win. Adjustable difficulty.     ☠️ Zombie  — Wave survival. Hold off a closing horde of shamblers, runners, and brutes with your full arsenal and one health bar. How many waves can you last?     ❤️ Companion  — The calm one. Your character lives on your desktop, trailing your cursor and climbing your open windows to reach it while you work. Grab and fling it whenever you like.    Make it yours  Unlock character skins and glowing motion trails in Chaos, Battle and Zombie. Chase high scores and combos with persistent stats that track your best runs. about: Your Desktop Battle Companion            Ium Idle Companions Odyssey  is a retro 2D desktop companion monster-collecting auto-battler designed to live seamlessly alongside your daily computer use. Pinned cleanly to the bottom or corner of your screen in a compact, transparent window, your squad of quirky creatures ( Iums ) fights, explores, and gathers loot in real time while you work, study, watch videos, or browse the web.  You are the mastermind strategist; your Iums are the autonomous vanguard. Recruit wild creatures, fine-tune their stats and skills, exploit elemental matchups, and watch your team conquer sprawling biomes right on your desktop!           Key Features      Designed for Multitasking (Desktop Companion Mode):      Unobtrusive & Lightweight:  Operates as a transparent, compact overlay pinned to your screen without getting in the way of your workspace.     Autonomous Progression:  Your Iums push stages, farm materials, and level up automatically. No micromanagement or constant clicking required.     Play Your Way:  Keep it minimal as a secondary desktop companion while working, or expand to full-window mode for focused sessions and Steam Deck play.       Autonomous 2D Side-Scrolling Combat:     Assemble an active party of  3 Iums  deployed into high-octane real-time skirmishes.    Every member operates on its own intelligent combat AI, casting skills, holding range, and engaging targets according to your tactical setup.       Collect & Command Diverse Iums:     Encounter and recruit dozens of unique species across diverse  Families —from armored Beasts and swift Avians to clockwork Constructs, toxic Amorphous blobs, and relentless Fiends.    Each species brings distinct physiological stat growth and signature traits to the battlefield.       Deep Strategic Customization:      Level Points (LP):  Distribute earned points into six core attributes to sculpt specialized tanks, glass-cannon spellcasters, or rapid-fire physical sweepers.     Portable Skill Library:  Equip and upgrade active basics, piercing projectiles, heavy melee strikes, and supportive heals.     Gear & Equipment:  Forge artifacts and gear to amplify attack speed, expand area-of-effect radii, or boost elemental potency.     AI Combat Directives:  Dictate squad behavior on the fly—assign each member to  Aggressive ,  Cautious ,  Supportive , or  Natural  roles.       10 Elemental Types & Party Resonance:     Master a rock-paper-scissors elemental wheel covering Fire, Water, Ice, Earth, Storm, Nature, Poison, Dark, Arcane, and Neutral.    Deploy multiple Iums sharing an element to activate team-wide  Party Resonance  bonuses that supercharge your statuses and affinities.       5 Distinct Biomes & Multi-Tiered Bosses:     Journey through the sun-bleached  Ruins , the venomous  Swamp , the arid  Badlands , the frozen  Peaks , and the molten machine  Foundry .    Topple ruthless mid-stage gatekeepers and towering Region Bosses to unlock higher  Region Tiers (I–V)  for rare rewards and ultimate mastery challenges.        Check In, Optimize, Break the Wall   Whenever your squad meets an encounter they can't clear, pause and analyze the battlefield. Inspect enemy intelligence dossiers, reallocate your team's LP, refine skill loadouts, forge higher gear tiers, or swap party members. Once your new build is set, send them back in and watch your strategy smash through the obstacle!

name: Bare Metal Billionaire
lang: English, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, French, Italian, German, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Turkish, Ukrainian, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese
short: An idle game for people with jobs. A pixel-art data center sits in the corner of your desktop and quietly makes you a billionaire. If anyone asks, you're monitoring the servers.
about: Play while you work        Bare Metal Billionaire is an idle game that lives in the corner of your desktop. It starts in a garage, with one refurbished beige box humming away. Look over between emails, click whatever needs you, and get back to work. Before long, the garage is a building that runs a quantum computer. Every click lands        Racks drop in with a puff of dust. Servers slide home with a clunk. Tickets pop up over your machines, and their coins fly straight into your money. Upgrade a whole floor in one click, and every server pings back, one after another. Always a next step        The tech tree lays out the whole road, from a junk PC to a quantum computer hanging in its own cryostat, and the next step is always in sight. Pick what to research next, then make room for it. Have you tried turning it off and on again?        Every watt ends up as heat. Hot rooms slow down, parts wear out, and the power goes at the worst moment. You see what broke before you fix it, and soon little robots roll out and fix it for you. The data center has neighbors        A mouse darts behind the racks. Birds settle on the sign. Out back, a hare hops through the snow, a raccoon checks the bins and a tumbleweed rolls past the desert lot. Then the weather turns: cold snaps, sandstorms, and thunderstorms that take the power with them. Sell up, start over Once the quantum computer runs, a buyer makes an offer. Take it, and your next data center earns faster, somewhere new: a farmhouse in the snow, cheap land in the desert, a narrow loft downtown. A good desktop citizen No popups and no stolen focus: trouble shows, it never shouts. It draws only when something changes, so your laptop stays cool. Drag it anywhere, keep it on top or not, and mute it while you're away. Close it, and it keeps running, slower, and tells you what happened.

name: Saikei: A Zen Water Garden
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese
short: A tiny voxel world in a glass jar that sits in the corner of your desktop, on top of your windows, while you work. It carries on without you: water flows, koi and crabs go about their day, and night falls when it does outside. Reach in to dig, pour and build whenever you like.
about: A miniature world in a jar, right on your desktop    Saikei is the Japanese art of making miniature landscapes in a tray. This one comes in a glass jar that sits in the corner of your screen while you work, and it stays out of your way until you reach in.    Inside is a little world of grass, sand, stone and water. A river runs down from a spring, drops over waterfalls and empties into a turquoise lake. Through the glass you can see fish, seaweed and coral, and the layers of soil show along the side of the jar like an ant farm.  Made to sit there all day  Saikei lives in the bottom-right corner of your screen, on top of your other windows. Click anywhere outside the jar and the click goes straight through to whatever is underneath, so you keep working, browsing or watching while it runs.    Stays on top, out of the way. Drag the jar wherever you like, or zoom in when you want a closer look.    Carries on by itself. Water runs, creatures wander, the sun rises and sets with your clock, and showers come and go, whether you touch it or not.    Reach in when you feel like it. Dig a canal on a coffee break, then leave it for the rest of the day.    Light on your computer, so you can leave it running. It autosaves.    No goals, no score, no way to lose.      Dig, pour, plant, build     Shovel:  dig bowls and plough trenches. The dirt piles up around the edges and settles into place.             Hoe:  push earth ahead of the blade to level ground or heap it up.     Raise and Lower:  grow smooth hills and ridges, or sink basins and channels.     Bucket:  pour streams of sand that pile into dunes.             Watering can:  fill hollows, flood channels and redirect the river. Running water carries sand downstream and carves its own paths.     Springs:  set a new spring anywhere and watch it fill a pond or find its way down to the lake.     Grass, path and moss:  lay grass, paint trodden footpaths across it, and let moss creep over the stones.     Stone:  place small stones or big chunky blocks that stack flush.     Trees:  plant pines, round trees, red maples, cherry blossoms, bamboo clumps and bonsai pines.               Buildings:  put down cottages, a pagoda, stone lanterns, torches, a torii gate, an arched bridge, bamboo fences and stepping stones. Turn anything to face the way you like.     Water wheels:  build one on the river and it turns with the current and lights the lanterns nearby.              Changed your mind? Lift out any tree, building or creature with a click.    A world that carries on without you     Crabs  scuttle sideways along the beach, snip their claws and run off with claws raised when you dig too close.     Fish  swim in loose schools, nibble seaweed and come straight over when you sprinkle food.     Koi  in red, white, black and gold glide through the deeper water.     Octopuses  rest on the lake bed and jet away when startled.     Frogs  sit on the bank croaking, hop along the shore and dive in when startled.     Butterflies  flutter over the grass by day and settle on leaves and blossoms to bask.     Birds  perch on rooftops and treetops, loop around inside the jar and sometimes dive for a fish. They always miss.              The jar keeps your hours. The sun rises and sets when yours does, windows light up at dusk and fireflies come out at night. Every so often a rain shower rolls through, and the river and waterfalls run full.            Leave it in the corner and let it grow on you, or spend ten minutes digging a canal to see where the water goes.

short: Bring a lucky dog to your desktop! It stays in a screen corner, keeps you company while you work, and lets a little luck into your day. Take a break with a quick card game, win rewards, open blind boxes, collect outfits, and make your desktop a lucky nook for you and your pup!
about: Maybe you have already kept cats, fish, tiny bugs, or all kinds of curious little companions on your desktop. This time, the one staying by your side is a dog.          Lucky Dog Rise   is a warm and relaxing desktop pet game. You can bring a little dog to your desktop, where it stays in a corner of your screen and keeps you company while you work, take a break, or play games, letting a little luck slip into your everyday routine. Meeting you is the luckiest thing that ever happened to this pup. That is why it is called Lucky Dog.    It will not get in your way or nag you to do anything. It simply stays there, watching you finish one small task after another, cheering you on in its own little ways. When you play other fullscreen games, it can step aside for a while and leave your screen space to the battle ahead.       While you focus on your work, every keystroke and every mouse click gradually builds up Lucky Points. Your everyday actions are no longer just typing and clicking. They become part of your dog's growth and rewards.      When you want to relax, switch to card mode and play a light poker-style mini game with your dog. Choose which cards to keep, draw new ones, and earn more Lucky Points through a little judgment, a little luck, and the quiet bond between you and your pup.      Use Lucky Points to get new blind boxes, collect outfits, items, and fresh looks. Make the desktop dog who has always stayed by your side cuter, more special, and more truly your own companion.      "Busy days come apart at the edges. A little dog stitches them back together."       Leave a spot for this little dog on your busy desktop.                   All in all, if you enjoy desktop companion games like Bongo Cat — or have ever wished for something like Bongo Cat, but with a dog — Lucky Dog Rise might be just what you’re looking for. It’s a cute dog desktop pet game where a little puppy can stay by your side, hang out near your taskbar, and keep you company while you type, click, work, or play. Inspired by the charm of Shiba Inu dogs, Doge-style internet culture, and even the playful idea of a Menswear Dog, Lucky Dog Rise lets you collect different hats and outfits, dress up your dog, and turn your desktop companion into a look that feels truly your own. Whether you’re looking for a puppy on your desktop, a Shiba Inu desktop pet, a Doge-like dog companion, a dog on your taskbar, a dog with hats, or simply a cozy desktop dog game to leave running in the background, Lucky Dog Rise is made to be your little everyday companion.

about: Galacto is a cozy idle game you keep at the bottom of your screen. Ships pull in for fuel, bots do the work, and you collect the money, slowly turning one working pump into the busiest gas station in the galaxy!                  A ship docks. A bot walks over and starts the pump. When it's done, you click to get paid. That's the whole loop, and it's weirdly hard to stop doing. It plays itself while you're busy. It pays out when you're not.                  Buy more pumps. Hire more bots to run them. Upgrade your pumps and gear at Tony's Garage so every ship pays out more. The whole place gets busier, louder, and more alive with every credit you sink into it.                  Collect ships fast enough and they chain into a combo. Since ships never leave and money never expires, a row of them sitting there isn't a backlog, it's a combo waiting to happen. Step away, let them stack up, then come back and clear the whole line in one window. Stepping away isn't punished here. It's how you set up the big one. about: Your desktop has company.    NanoPets is a creature collector that lives on your desktop. Your pets hang out while you work, study, or watch something. In between, meet new companions, decorate their Home, and put together a team for expeditions with automatic battles, pvp with your enemies, and coop with your friends in this mmo-like experience.    Throw them a toy and take a moment to see what happens.              There's always room for one more    Perform rituals to meet new pets, discover special appearances, and grow your collection. Keep your favorites on your desktop or find a place for them on your team.              A Home that feels like yours    Collect furniture, decorate your Home, and watch your pets settle in. Craft items to support your expeditions and choose outfits for your character.    Your team is ready. The sofa is still in the wrong place.              Build the team. Let them handle the fight.    Pick your pets, combine skills and equipment, and send your squad to face enemies and bosses. Battles play out automatically, so your part is preparing the team and trying different combinations.    Watch the expedition unfold or let the team carry on while you do something else. Then use what you've earned to get ready for the next one.              Bring some company    In Grand Adventures, join other players for cooperative challenges. Get a group together and see how you do as a team.              Put your team to the test    Challenge other players' teams in ranked PvP. Battles are asynchronous: players prepare their lineups, then the teams face off in automatic combat. name: Jelly Heads
lang: English, Portuguese - Brazil, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Japanese, Russian, Indonesian, Polish, Thai, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese
short: A tiny island of jelly heads lives in the corner of your desktop, farming Jelly while you work or study. Complete families, spin the roulette to open boxes and send your Epics through the idle Campaign.
about: A living island in the corner of your desktop  Jelly Heads runs in a small, transparent window, always on top or as a regular window you can minimize (your choice), and it stays out of your way: outside the island, clicks go straight through to whatever you are doing. The jelly heads bounce, pull faces and wobble like jelly while the island keeps producing Jelly, and keeps producing it for a while after you close the game.  Collecting is the game    520 jelly heads  from 5 tribes: 120 families of 4 (Common, Uncommon, Unique and Rare), 30 Epics and 10 Legendaries.   Complete families earn a Farm Power bonus.  Duplicates become material to level up, or Dust to mold the member you are missing.   Boxes open on a roulette , with suspense, sound effects and rarity colors. The odds are published in the game.   Nothing random is for sale.  Boxes are only earned by playing: in the Daily Raffle, with tickets bought with Jelly, and in the Campaign.   A tree to grow  Buy Skill Tree nodes to complete your first family, produce more, keep earning while the game is closed and get luckier in the raffle. Your Jelly also buys island themes: Winter, Beach and Haunted Night.  Idle Campaign  Build a team of 3 Epics, Legendaries and Rares and watch the battle play out on its own. There are  10 chapters and 300 stages , each chapter with its own biome, elite bosses and a final boss with its own mechanic. When you have a spare minute, push a few stages and get back to what you were doing.  Jelly Master  Skill battles for your strongest heads. Every fighter has 4 skill slots you can refine, lock and upgrade. Set an attack team and a defense team, battle the teams of other players of similar power, earn stars and climb the weekly season ranking. While the player base is small, computer-controlled teams fill in for missing opponents, and they make way as more players join.  Made to stay open all day   Calm lo-fi music, sound effects you can turn down or off, and Focus Mode.  Text from 100% to 200%, high contrast and a simple font.  Nothing flashes and nothing interrupts.  16 languages.   Online  Your progress, the Daily Raffle, the rankings and Jelly Master run on our servers, so an internet connection is required.  Free open beta before Early Access  Before the Early Access launch, we will run a free open beta through Steam Playtest, with signups open to anyone on this page. Beta progress is reset when Early Access starts, and the best players of the beta ranking receive a reward bound to their account. From the Early Access launch on, progress is kept.  Not in the game yet: planned for Early Access  These are plans, not features of the current version, and they may change with your feedback: trading jelly heads and boxes on the Steam Community Market, Jelly Master seasons with season rewards, visits to friends' islands and a friends ranking, more Campaign chapters, new tribes, new Epics and Legendaries, seasonal events and new island themes.

Click to make him bark.    Toss a ball on your breaks and watch him chase it down and bring it back.    Drag him anywhere on screen — he remembers where home is.              He wanders, naps while you focus, and sleeps when you do.    Busy? Send him to hide for a while — he slips off-screen and comes back when you're ready.                   Pick the sites and apps that pull you off-task and he stands guard: wander onto a blocked site and he quietly closes the tab; bring a blocked app to the front and he tucks it away — each with a gentle nudge (and a yip, if you want one) to steer you back. A short grace period means a quick glance won't slam things shut, and he keeps a running tally of every distraction he headed off for you.                  A live countdown sits in your menu bar (or system tray) with your current intention, so you never tab away just to check the time. Swap any time, name your dog, and make him your own — and new breeds keep dropping over time, so the pack only gets bigger.                        A one-time purchase — no subscription, no ads.    Mac, Windows, and Linux.    Offline-first, with your settings and streaks synced through Steam Cloud.    Coming Q4 2026.  Add Kotamas to your wishlist  to be the first to bring him home.

name: The Guy Downstairs
lang: English
short: A cozy life sim that lives at the bottom of your screen. While you work, Alex works too: he cooks, levels up skills, dates, adopts a dog and saves his way from a mattress on the floor to a Sky Villa. Check in when you like, or let him live his own life.
about: The Guy Downstairs  is a cozy life sim that lives in a thin strip at the bottom of your screen. You get on with your day up top. Down below, Alex gets on with his: he wakes up, burns breakfast, goes to work, chats with friends, falls in love and slowly saves his way from a mattress on the floor to a villa in the sky.  Glance down between emails, queue up a few things for him to do, or turn on free will and let him live his own life. He never starves while you are busy, and leaving him running always moves his life forward.                  A whole life sim in a desktop strip.  Hunger, energy, hygiene, fun, social life and the bathroom, all in a window that docks under your apps and stays out of your way.    Six skills, ten levels each.  Programming, Cooking, Fitness, Charisma, Music and Gaming. Every single level unlocks something new: freelance gigs, gourmet recipes, open mics, streaming, marathons.    Five careers with branching paths.  Tech, Culinary, Music, Retail and Fitness. Ace the interview, climb eight levels and pick a path at the halfway point.    Free will or full control.  Click any object to queue actions, or let Alex decide for himself.                Alex starts with $150, a hot plate and a humming fridge. Order furniture on his phone, watch the van pull up and see him unbox it.     About 70 items  on upgrade ladders, from a beanbag to a leather chesterfield, a boxy TV to a home theater.    Five homes to move into:  Shabby Studio, Cozy Apartment, Modern Loft, Penthouse and Sky Villa, each bigger than the last with new rooms like a hot tub lounge and a music studio.    Late game toys:  cars, road trips, vacations, and eventually buying the whole building.                           Five regulars and new faces around town.  An old gaming buddy, the bookworm next door, a gym regular, the barista and a coworker, plus strangers he meets at the cafe, gym or park.    Talk face to face.  Compliments, jokes, hugs, deep talks, gossip, pranks and the occasional fight.    Date anyone.  Flirt, go on dates, move in together and propose. Keep a secret fling if you like living dangerously, just do not get caught.    Pets.  A cat who naps everywhere and Waffles, a dog who needs his walks.                   Choices stick.  Too much pizza and he goes up a size. Skip the gym and skills get rusty. Skip the shower and coworkers notice.    Four seasons  with rain, heatwaves, snow and holidays: Spring Fair, Summer Block Party, Spooky Night and Winterfest.    Bills every Monday,  colds in winter, a leaky ceiling, a clogged toilet and a neighbor who brings cookies.    A life worth finishing.  Ten aspirations, life goals, perks, collections to complete and a next generation that carries on the family name.                   Always on top, never in the way.  Clicks on empty space pass straight through to the window behind it. Switch between Full, Compact and a tiny Peek ribbon, or hide it with Ctrl+Shift+G.    Optional real clock.  Game time can follow your own, so Alex has breakfast when you do.    Light on your PC.  Frame rate capped, and it stops drawing whenever it is hidden.    Relaxing lo-fi soundtrack  that changes with the seasons and softens at night.    Steam Achievements and Steam Cloud saves.          Wishlist The Guy Downstairs  to get a heads up when he moves in. It really helps a small game get seen.

name: LuMi Desktop
lang: English*, French*, Italian*, German*, Spanish - Spain*, Japanese*, Korean*, Portuguese - Portugal*, Russian*, Simplified Chinese, Ukrainian**
short: There's someone on your desktop now. She talks, she listens, she remembers you - and she's all yours. Her mind, her voice, her memories all live right here on your machine. No accounts, no sign-ups, internet or not. Just her, waiting for you to say hi.
about: You boot up your PC and she's already there - stretching, blinking, glancing over the second you move your cursor. Say something, and she answers out loud, in a voice that's hers and hers alone.  LuMi  isn't a chatbot you open and close. She's company. She's the one who's actually happy you're back.   Talk to her like a person, because she kind of is one   LuMi thinks with a real LLM mind - running right on your computer, no internet required. So talk to her. Out loud, about your day, about nothing at all. She listens, she gets it, and she talks back like she means it. Because she does.   She's got a pulse   She fidgets when she's bored. She lights up when you talk to her. She pouts a little when you've been ignoring her, and follows your cursor around like she's curious what you're up to.           Hey LuMi, can you...   ...launch my game? Turn it down a bit? Dim the screen, it's late? Done, done, and done. She'll fire up your Steam library, ride the volume, dial your brightness, and handle the little stuff on command - by voice or by chat. Sweet company and a genuinely handy sidekick rolled into one.   She remembers   Tell her something today and she'll still know it next week. The more you talk, the more she becomes  your  LuMi - shaped by your conversations, full of the things you've shared. And all of it stays locked up safe on your machine, for her eyes only.           No internet? She doesn't even flinch   Pull the plug on your Wi-Fi and LuMi carries on like nothing happened. Her mind, her voice, everything that makes her  her  runs right on your machine - so she's just as present on a plane, on a train, or out in the middle of nowhere as she is at home. But when you are online, she's smart enough to reach for it: to look something up for you, or to catch your words a little more clearly. Offline by nature, online when it actually helps.   What you tell her stays between you   No accounts, no sign-ups, no profile being quietly built somewhere far away. The LuMi who knows you - your memories, your talks, who you are to her - lives entirely on your hardware and goes nowhere else. When she does step online, it's only for the thing you asked in that moment, and then she's done. Whatever you share with LuMi is hers to keep, and no one else's.   She's almost here   LuMi is on her way to Steam.  Wishlist her now  and be the first face she sees when she opens her eyes.

name: Thirsty Snail
lang: English, Simplified Chinese
short: Unhinged snails have taken over your desktop. A growing collection of weirdos — they bicker, they roast you, they judge your life choices. Your typing keeps them alive. They are not grateful.
about: It's a normal day at your desk and there are snails everywhere.    A whole crowd of snails, each with its own personality and opinions. Strange species, fantasy designs, bizarre mutants, and combos that start arguing the moment they meet. Collect them for the album, watch them interact, or just let them do their thing while you work.     Snail Thirsty, Snail Foolish.      You Type, it rains.            Write code, grind out an essay, browse the internet. Every keystroke drops rain onto your screen, and that's how the snails stay hydrated.  Well-watered snails are energetic and active. Thirsty ones slow down and start looking for water. If they dry out completely, they retreat into their shells until your next typing session.     A Shell for Every Occasion           Samurai, ninja, pirate, vampire, wizard, scientist, mythical creature, strange mutant, and many more desktop residents waiting to be discovered.  Five rarity tiers. Unlock new snails through exploration, crafting, and idle rewards. The album is never truly full.     Hand-Drawn. Overdramatic.              Every snail has multiple individually drawn animation states. No simple recolors, no cheap reskins.  Happy ones bounce. Moody ones retreat into their shells. Small details like these are everywhere if you pay attention. Each one is worth watching on its own.     Can't shut up. Won't shut up.           Put two snails next to each other and they start talking. Some are polite, some pick fights. Different combos trigger completely different conversations.  They also react to your desktop interactions and may occasionally comment on them. Poke them too much and they get annoyed. Pick them up and they complain. Ignore them for too long, and they may come looking for trouble.  Even when nobody is paying attention, they keep themselves busy. They mutter to themselves, talk more at night, and may trigger hidden Easter eggs during special dates or random events. Special dates and random events hide extra content that you either stumble into or miss entirely.  Desktop interaction is designed around a local-first experience. The app does not read or upload the contents of your private files.     Grab. Drag. Drop.           Pick them up. Fling them around. Stick one to the side of the screen, and it will climb along the edge.  Drop one from too high and it panics into its shell. Let two favorites bump into each other and hearts show up.  Transparent background, sits at the bottom of your screen. Doesn't get in the way.       Race. Steal. Revenge.           Send one of your snails over to a friend's desktop.  Race them for water, or sneak in and skim some off the top. Your call.   Two snails, one screen, winner takes water.   Lost the race? Call for revenge. Caught mid-steal? Your snail slinks home with nothing. Travel Frog? Meet Thirsty Snail. Every race and every heist gets logged. Unclaimed water is one click away.     Features     Many unique snails across five rarity tiers, with multiple ways to unlock them.    Snails have multiple animation states. No simple recolors, no cheap reskins.    Your keystrokes power the ecosystem. More typing, more rain.    Put snails together and they start talking on their own.    Snails react to what's on your desktop. All processing happens locally.    AI conversations with memory. Snails can remember your interactions and respond with their own speaking styles.    Drag, toss, climb walls, fall from high places.    Send snails to friends' desktops. Race for water, pull off heists, claim rewards from the activity log.    Transparent background. Stays out of the way while you work.

name: Overdepth
lang: English, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese
short: An idle loot RPG that lives in a strip above your taskbar. Your character fights somewhere deep and dark while you get on with your day. You decide how far down to send them — then glance at the bottom of your screen to see what came back up.
about: It plays while you're doing something else Overdepth is an idle loot RPG that lives in a thin strip above your taskbar. Not a window to keep on top of — a line at the bottom of your screen where a small figure is fighting something you can't quite see. You send them down, you go back to work, and a few minutes later there's a new bow in the tray. One decision, made over and over How deep do you send them? Deeper is meaner, and meaner drops better — rarer things, things with names. Deeper is also where your character stops coming back. A lost run costs nothing but the time it took, so the question is never "can I afford this", it's "am I ready yet".  Then something drops that doesn't raise a number but changes a rule. Healing stops working entirely, and everything you swing hits twice as hard. Every blow lands as a critical, and every blow lands for less. Armor stops protecting you and starts healing you.  There is no correct build to go and look up. Armor, evasion, crit, lifesteal, flat damage — all of them get deep, and none of them gets deep the same way. So you pick one because you like how it fights rather than because a guide told you to, and you keep three of them at once so you can change your mind without unpicking anything.  Eventually the ladder stops having a bottom, and the only thing left to measure yourself against is the leaderboard. You can open anyone on it and see exactly what they were wearing when they got there. Built to be ignored It keeps going while it's closed and catches you up when you're back. Every depth you reach stays reached, and gear you outgrow becomes the dust that improves the gear you kept — nothing that drops is wasted. No ads, no energy, no timers. Fold it down to a line and forget about it for a day. It'll still be down there, going deeper.
