name: AwarePilot
lang: English
short: AwarePilot is a real-time AI screen navigator for Windows. Ask AI about what’s currently on your screen, reduce repeated screenshots and app switching, and keep help close at hand with compact desktop controls and Privacy Mode.
about: AwarePilot is a real-time AI screen navigator that lets you ask AI questions directly about what's on your Windows screen.  It reduces the hassle of repeatedly taking and uploading screenshots, switching between windows, or leaving your current application to interact with a separate AI service.  With AwarePilot always available on your screen, you can ask AI questions about whatever you're currently working on.  【Three AI Platforms. One Interface.】  AwarePilot is currently developing multi-AI functionality that will support three major AI platforms: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, and Google Gemini.  The goal is to eliminate the need to open each AI service separately or constantly switch between browser tabs while working.  Through a single, unified interface, you'll be able to select different AI models based on your tasks and preferences.   Planned AI Models (Upon Completion of Multi-AI Support)   ・OpenAI: Auto / Quick / Deep / GPT-6 Astra  ・Claude: Auto / Haiku / Sonnet / Opus  ・Gemini: Auto / Flash-Lite / Flash / Pro  The system is designed to let you use these AI models with shared Credits, without having to obtain or configure API keys for each provider.   Note:  OpenAI functionality is currently implemented. Claude and Gemini support is still under development and testing and is not yet available to general users.  【Key Features】  ・AI-powered screen recognition that lets you ask questions about what's displayed on your Windows screen  ・Compact interface that stays in the bottom-right corner of your screen  ・Two display modes: Minimal and Navigation  ・Multi-AI switching between OpenAI, Claude, and Gemini (in development)  ・AI model selection based on your needs  ・Conversation Context to maintain continuity throughout your conversations  ・Project Resume to make it easier to pick up where you left off  ・Privacy Mode to pause screen sharing with AI whenever needed  ・Purchase additional Credits using Steam Wallet  【Find What You Need with AI-Powered Highlighting】  "Where can I find this setting?" "I can't find the feature I'm looking for."  When you're unsure where something is, simply describe what you want to do and ask the AI.  AwarePilot analyzes your current screen, identifies the relevant buttons or controls, and visually highlights their locations directly on your screen.  You don't need to know the exact name of a feature. Just ask in your own words.  Instead of relying on written instructions alone, you can see where to go on your actual workspace, making even complex software easier and more intuitive to navigate.  【Make Your Everyday Windows Workflow Easier】  AwarePilot is designed to help you get AI assistance directly within your everyday Windows workflow, whether you're using a web browser, system settings, programming environment, creative software, or other desktop applications.  Whether you're troubleshooting an error, navigating complicated settings, or fixing a problem in your code, AwarePilot is there to help.  You can ask AI questions without leaving your current workspace or constantly switching between windows.  Screen information is captured when you submit a question. AwarePilot does not continuously capture your screen.  【Privacy Matters】  When Privacy Mode is enabled, AwarePilot stops sending screen information to AI.  Privacy Mode is also automatically activated during Steam purchase transactions, preventing screen capture and transmission to AI while the purchase is in progress.  Privacy Mode remains active until you manually select Resume.   AwarePilot — Stay in your workflow. Bring AI closer.

name: Widget Workshop

about: About the Software   Widget Workshop is a Windows desktop widget management application that lets you place clocks, weather displays, calendars, sticky notes, desktop pets, games, and more directly on your desktop. It provides centralized control over widget activation, visibility, settings, and permissions.   Widget Management   Widget Workshop supports importing local widgets and syncing subscriptions from the Steam Workshop. Users can manage widget permissions with fine-grained controls, reducing the risk of malicious widgets accessing system resources. Widgets that support customization can also be personalized directly from the management interface.   Lightweight Performance   Through a range of performance optimizations, Widget Workshop minimizes resource usage, allowing it to run smoothly and almost unnoticed on most PCs. Enhance your desktop without compromising everyday performance.   Widget Creation   For creators, Widget Workshop provides tools for managing local widget projects, validation, testing, and uploading to the Steam Workshop. These tools streamline the entire workflow, from development and testing to publishing.   Effortless Development   Widget Workshop offers an Agent Plugin and accompanying documentation on GitHub (wangdiandao/widget-workshop-dev), compatible with AI coding agents such as Codex and Claude Code. Creators can develop widgets using natural language, significantly lowering the barrier to creating content for Widget Workshop.

name: SwissBaha Game Assistant
lang: English, German, Turkish
short: Get ready to play in the Kepler interface. Choose Basic Mode for a focused start or Advanced Mode for system monitoring and preparation tools. Launch games, preview closing targets and manage supported settings and caches. English, German and Turkish.
about: Bring your pre-game routine together. SwissBaha Game Assistant combines game launching, system monitoring and maintenance tools in one Windows desktop app.  One assistant. Two ways to get ready.  The Kepler interface combines a dark background, warm accents and clear, rounded cards. Choose the view that suits your routine.    Basic Mode:  Choose your game, launch it without closing programs, or select Gaming only for aggressive preparation. Review the actual program and service targets before you start. Force closing remains a separate permission and is off by default.    Advanced Mode:  The Control Desk brings system readings, game and launcher settings, caches, disks, programs and services into one workspace. Resize the borderless window from its edges and move it using the header.   Get ready to play, with control over each step   Scan your Steam libraries or add your own games.   Choose a launch-only, light preparation, streaming or aggressive preparation profile.   Use Action Preview to inspect targeted programs and services before making changes.   Open your chosen helper apps and web pages alongside your game.   Make everyday tasks easier   Monitor CPU, RAM, GPU, disks, programs and services from one screen.   Back up and restore supported game settings, and manage validated shader and cache locations.   Investigate problems with diagnostic reports and action logs. Shareable diagnostic reports mask your username and local paths; review their contents before sharing.   Get started with an optional four-step tour. Use the interface in English, German or Turkish.   Getting started and important details  Read and accept the information notice before using the app. Then select or add your game and check its paths. In Basic Mode, review the Before you start summary; in Advanced Mode, use Action Preview before choosing a preparation profile.  Forced termination is off by default. Save open work and review your close list. Critical Windows components and anti-cheat processes are protected. Aggressive preparation and forced termination include additional risk warnings; restore hidden warnings under Settings > General.  Games added through Steam or manually can use game launching and helper apps. Settings backups and cache operations depend on the game and its configured, validated paths. Performance or FPS improvements are not guaranteed.  The app does not modify game executables or anti-cheat systems. Game-specific integrations are provided for compatibility only, with no official endorsement or affiliation from the respective publishers.  Support and feedback  For help, use Discussions in the Steam Community Hub or the support link on this store page. Include the app version, Windows version and exact error text, without sharing personal information.

about: Island-to-Island Treasure Hunt  You've got a metal detector in your hand and your pet at your side. You step onto the island, sweep the ground, and dig wherever the signal leads. Most of the time it's a nail. Now and then it's a ring its owner gave up on, one nobody even remembers losing.  Most of what you dig up is worthless. The money comes from people whose lost things you bring back, and the big scores sit inside chests. Finding a chest is luck. Opening one takes time.          Islands  Once you've swept most of an island and all you have left is a few nails and a rusty screw, you move on to the next one. Every island has people to talk to and fresh ground to dig.  Pet and Friends  Your pet tags along. Friends can join too, with 1-4 players sweeping the same island together.  Night and the Gambler  When the sun goes down, a shady gambler pulls up to the island in his boat. You can go try your luck, but be careful. He might be a good friend too.  On Your Desktop  Island Detector is a desktop companion. Even when you close the game and get back to work, your detector keeps running, sweeping the island and collecting treasure for you. Whatever it found is waiting for you when you get back.  Add it to your wishlist so you don't miss the release.

name: DeskDash: Desktop Widgets
lang: English
short: DeskDash puts live, interactive widgets on your Windows desktop background. Launch apps and games from a shelf, tick off your tasks, control your music and watch your PC, right on the wallpaper. Swap the Windows taskbar for a dock, and add more widgets free from the built-in marketplace.
about: DeskDash turns your Windows desktop background into a live dashboard. Widgets sit on the wallpaper itself, behind your windows, and they are not just for show: launch your apps and games, keep your tasks, control your music and show what your PC is doing. Drag, resize and restyle everything until the desktop is yours.          Widgets that do things    Shelf: launch tiles from dropped files and apps, a folder, or your installed games    Todo and Habits: a task list and a weekly habit tracker that remember what you tick off    Schedule and Calendar: a weekly timetable and a month view, with reminders    Now Playing: album art, track info and controls for whatever plays on your PC    Steam Recent: your last played games with hours and achievements, one click to launch    System Controls: wifi, volume and battery in one bar    And the essentials: clocks, weather and forecasts, system monitors, a focus timer, sticky notes and more, with new widgets added to the marketplace all the time.  Replace the Windows taskbar  Pick a taskbar from the marketplace, a floating macOS-style dock, a gaming focused sidebar, or anything else. Your pinned apps, open windows, Start menu and tray come with it. The Windows taskbar comes back with one click.          Matches your wallpaper, even a live one  The Automatic theme takes its colors from your wallpaper and follows live wallpaper apps too. Prefer your own look? Build a theme, or restyle any single widget.          Every monitor gets its own layout  Run a full dashboard on one screen and keep another clean. Layouts remember their display and come back when you reconnect it.  There when you want it, gone when you don't  Double click the desktop and every widget hides. Double click again and they're back. Show desktop (Win+D) keeps your widgets in view, and a low performance mode is there for older PCs.          Safe by design  Every widget runs in its own sandbox, with no reach into your files, your network or other widgets. Before a widget runs, you see what it asks for and you decide what it gets. API keys stay in Windows Credential Manager, and a misbehaving widget only affects itself.  Build your own  Widgets are plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript, with no build step. Turn on Developer mode for a starter template, typed SDK files and widget inspection, then submit your widget to the marketplace for everyone to use.

name: Deskwake AFK Engine
lang: English
short: Pick a scene. Pick a color. Set a sleep timer (with or without sound). Deskwake stays hidden until you stop touching the keyboard or mouse. Then it fades in across every monitor. 100 scenes, 12 UI themes, randomizer and auto-cycle.
about: Deskwake waits quietly in your tray. When you step away from your PC, it fades a living scene across your whole desktop, on every monitor. An aurora ripples over your work. A black hole bends the starlight. Rain gathers on the glass. The moment you touch the mouse or keyboard, it's gone and your desktop is exactly as you left it.  No wallpaper replaced. No internet. Just your desk, coming alive while you're not looking.       Every scene is drawn live, frame by frame, with soft light, depth and motion. Nothing is a looping video. Each one is composed around the edges of your screen, so your windows stay readable underneath, and each recolors itself to the palette you choose.           Water & Rain : Rain on Glass, Reef, Electric Jellyfish, Bioluminescent Shore, Manta Drift, Monsoon Puddles           Sky & Weather : Aurora Curtain, Lighthouse, Thunderhead, Mountain Milky Way, Fireworks, Frost Creep           Cosmos : Black Hole, Ringed Planet, Total Eclipse, Galaxy Spiral, Supernova, Star Trails           Sci-Fi : Warp Gate, Holo Globe, Orbital Station, UFO Scene, Tesla Coil, Plasma Tendrils           Nature : Cherry Blossom Tree, Koi Pond, Bamboo Grove, Butterfly Migration, Murmuration, Mushroom Grotto           Cozy & Sweet : Fairy Lights, Candlelight, Snow Globe, Fireplace, Lantern River, Ferris Wheel           Retro : Retro Horizon, Neon Skyline, Digital Rain, Disco Ball, Arcade Attract Mode, Pixel Aquarium           Abstract : Reaction Bloom, Maze Weave, Ferrofluid, Ink in Water, Kaleidoscope, Stained Glass      Stays out of your way     ● Smart AFK  Deskwake knows the difference between "away" and "busy". It stays hidden while you're in a call, watching a video, playing with a controller or running a full-screen game, and it pauses while your PC is locked.   ● Instant return  Any key or mouse movement and the scene is gone.   ● Click-through and always on top  on every monitor, with no window to manage.   ● Light on your PC  A new GPU renderer draws scenes using a fraction of a percent of your CPU. No graphics card? It switches to a CPU mode and tunes itself to fit.   ● Game-friendly  While it waits it uses almost nothing, never steals focus and never covers a full-screen game unless you ask it to.   ● Multi-monitor aware  Scenes built around one subject, like a ringed planet or a lighthouse, stay on your main screen, while your other monitors get a matching ambient layer.      Make it yours     ● The Dial  one round control for everything, with 12 themes to match your setup.   ● 60 palettes  or build your own with a screen eyedropper. Every scene recolors to match.   ● Speed, Density and Motion  for every scene, and Left / Centre / Right placement for hero scenes.   ● Auto-Cycle  through scenes on a timer, or  Randomize  the whole look in one click.   ● Preview  any scene for 30 seconds without waiting.   ● AFK Audio  play your own track when the scene fades in, with fade-in, clip range and looping.   ● Calm mode  softens bright accents and fast motion.     Photosensitivity notice: some scenes contain lightning, sparks, fireworks or moving light. Calm mode softens them, and Deskwake avoids strobe-like flashes, but please take care if you are sensitive to flashing light.

short: Wake a forgotten museum of optical illusions with your robot curator, Luna. Explore its wonders, fill the galleries with your own creations, and go as deep as you like: shape every detail, make illusions dance to your music, and stage whole shows. Cozy, psychedelic, endlessly remixable.
about: Wake a forgotten museum. Fill it with impossible wonders.  Illusion Remix is a cozy, psychedelic creative sandbox where you explore a museum of optical illusions, curate your own galleries, and create mesmerizing visuals that move to your music. Meet Luna, your robot curator, and discover a museum where there's always something new to make your own.            Wake the Museum  Step into a Vortex Tunnel that'll make your head spin. Ride a Haunted Swing that spins the whole room around you. Lose yourself in a mirrored Infinity Room. Discover ten extraordinary illusion experiences as you explore and bring the museum back to life. These aren't just pictures on a wall. They're real spaces you can step inside inspired by real life abstract museum experiences.            Curate Your Wing  Turn empty rooms into galleries worth exploring. Hang your favorite illusions on brass rails, arrange benches and plants, and set the lighting to create just the right atmosphere. Take commissions from Luna and your patrons, welcome visitors, and see which pieces capture their attention as your museum's reputation grows.  No timers. No fail states. Just a museum that's yours to shape, at your own pace.            Go as Deep as You Like  Start with a handcrafted preset and make something beautiful in seconds, or dive into the full editor to shape every detail of an illusion: geometry, color, motion, distortion, glow, and more.  Then make it move to your music. Map different parts of your audio to different visual parameters, and fine-tune the strength and smoothing of every reaction. Let the beat drive the motion, the bass transform the colors, or the music bend your patterns into something entirely unexpected.  When your creation is ready, bring it out of Luna's Studio and unveil it on your museum wall.            Stage a Show, Take It Anywhere  Your creations don't have to stay in the museum. In Remix Stage, arrange illusions on a beat-synced timeline, connect them with transitions, add FX hits, and build a complete audiovisual show around your favorite song.  Export videos, GIFs, and images to share your work. Turn your creations into live wallpapers for Wallpaper Engine or Lively, or run them full-screen as a music visualizer using your own tracks. Share your creations with the community through Steam Workshop.    Features:    Real-time optical illusion editor with deep customization    Handcrafted patterns and ready-to-use presets       A museum with many immersive illusion experiences, a curating loop, commissions, critic reviews, and Luna's story    Curate your own galleries with display rails, furnishings, and customizable lighting    Create optical illusions with a real-time editor, handcrafted presets, and 19+ base patterns    Map audio to motion, color, distortion, glow, and more, with individual control over each reaction    Use your own music or react to audio playing on your desktop    Build and perform beat-synced audiovisual shows in Remix Stage (full game)    Export videos, GIFs, and images, and create live wallpapers for Wallpaper Engine and Lively    Share your creations through Steam Workshop and earn Steam achievements    Desktop Companion Mode - Bring Luna to life on your desktop and watch her use your creations!      Illusion Remix will continue to grow with new patterns, presets, polish, and improvements shaped by player feedback.    Try the Free Demo  The free demo lets you explore the Atrium and its wonders, experiment in the Remix Lab, curate your first gallery room, and experience Opening Night.  The full game expands your museum with more rooms to curate, the Lower Galleries, Remix Stage, additional patterns, and more creative possibilities.  The museum is waiting. Come see what you'll create.  Launching January 14, 2027.

short: A cozy 3D printer simulator. Pick your colors, start your prints, and watch voxel models grow. Snap off the supports, ship orders, and buy upgrades for your workshop. Engage actively to grow faster or leave it as a relaxing idle companion on your desktop that you check in on.
about: Print In Progress  is a cozy management sim about the simple satisfaction of running a 3D print shop. Take on orders, manage your filament, and watch voxel models come to life layer by layer. Ship your creations to earn cash, then reinvest it to grow your hobby into a full-scale workshop.          Not every customer is in a rush. Decide how you want to manage your time:     Fast Orders:  High-pressure, high-reward. These need to be finished quickly but pay out a premium.     Slow Orders:  Low-pressure, lower pay. Perfect for when you want to take your time and enjoy the hum of the machines.            Every model needs material. Before you hit "Start," make sure you have enough in the tank.     Filament Management:  Manage four different types of filament. The more complex the model, the more plastic it consumes.     Auto-Generation:  Unlock upgrades that will help you get filament easily so you can focus on the bigger picture.            Every print is a trade-off. Tweak your settings to match your goals:     The Detail Slider:  Go for a "blocky" fast print or a super-fine detailed model. High detail earns more money but keeps the printer busy much longer.     Overdrive Mode:  Need it done  now ? Crank the speed. Just be careful.. pushing your printer too hard increases the risk of a failed print!     Cinematic Mode:  Hide UI, get popcorn and lean back while watching the printer work. Becomes a satisfying time-lapse once your printer reaches insane speeds.            The job isn't done when the printer stops. You’ve got to get your hands a little dirty:     Clean the Print:  Satisfyingly break off the support structures to reveal the finished model.     The Shipping Toss:  Aim and flick your finished product into the shipping box. Try not to miss!            Take that hard-earned cash and pour it back into your passion:     The Upgrade Tree:  Unlock new models, better printer parts, and helpful automation.     Expand Your Fleet:  Why have one printer when you can have four?     Make it Yours:  Decorate your workspace. Take any print from your inventory and place it on your shelves or worktable to make the shop feel like home.            Play however fits your mood:     Engaged Mode:  For when you want to lean in. Prints are faster, progression is snappier, and the shop is busy.     Idle Mode:  Turn the game into a "tiny Desktop Companion." Let your tiny 3d printer run as a cozy screensaver in a corner while you work or study, and check in on your prints whenever you need a break.      Now it's time to create your little workshop!

name: TypePuppy
lang: English, Simplified Chinese
short: Meet Puppy, a little dog on your desktop, keeping you company as you work or study. Type or click to earn points, then open a chest for random outfits to dress Puppy up. Collect them in your gallery, and fuse extras into rarer items. Puppy stays by your side, cheering you on the whole way.
about: TypePuppy is a relaxing, feel-good desktop pet-raising game. A little dog named Puppy lives right on your computer desktop, quietly keeping you company as you go about your daily work and study. There's no complicated controls or competitive pressure — just use your computer as normal (typing, clicking) and you'll grow alongside Puppy without even noticing, collecting your own unique outfits along the way.   Earn Points Through Everyday Interaction   Puppy tracks your keystrokes and mouse clicks in real time and converts them into points. Just keep working or studying as usual, and your points will keep adding up.   Open Chests, Get Outfits   Every time you reach 1,000 points (once every 30 minutes), you can open a mystery chest and receive a random cosmetic item — hats, skins, and more. Items come in four rarity tiers: N, R, SR, and SSR. The higher the tier, the lower the drop rate and the harder it is to obtain.   Drop Rates   N: 90%  R: 9%  SR: 0.9%  SSR: 0.1%   Outfits & Collection   Manage everything you own in "My Items" and switch Puppy's look anytime. Check your collection progress for every item in the "Gallery."   Fusion System   Duplicate lower-tier items are never wasted — combine 10 items of the same rarity in the Synth to obtain one item of the next rarity tier up.   Achievements   The game features a variety of built-in achievements covering total keystrokes, time spent together, items collected, and more. Complete them to record every moment you've spent with Puppy.   Thoughtful Companion Reminders   Puppy says hello the first time you turn on your computer each day, and randomly reminds you to rest and drink water after a while of focused work.You can also customize the timing and content of reminders to make the companionship feel truly your own.

about: You don't choose your spirit animal. It watches first, quietly testing who you are, then it chooses you back: a bear, a wolf, or a capybara that is somehow always chill. Once matched, it moves right onto your screen.                      It settles on a small patch of land at the edge of your display. It wanders around, gathers berries, catches fish, and rests under trees. You can leave it alone or interact directly: drag food over, point out the lake, or let it explore on its own.    It lives its own life on your screen, mostly content on its own. But not entirely: sometimes it needs your hand to reach a stone, catch a fish, or get through a hard season. Your daily work fuels its world. The more you type and click, the more it eats, grows, and prepares for winter. It isn't a rigid productivity app, just a quiet companion you help become its best self, one that thrives whenever you get things done.              Watch the seasons change, discover beehives, and unlock new skins from ancient stones. It already knows which spirit is yours. All that's left is to meet it.

lang: English, Japanese
short: Welcome to Rabby's Rainbow Farm! Rabby the rabbit moves onto your desktop and keeps tending it while you do other things. Give a simple command, and he'll till, plant, and harvest on his own. Chat with visitors who drop by, and watch your farm grow, little by little.
about: Welcome to Rabby's Rainbow Farm!   Rabby's Rainbow Farm is a cozy, idle farming game that lives right on your desktop. You never till the soil yourself — instead, you give commands to Rabby the rabbit, and he takes care of the work on his own.        Always There, Never in the Way   Rabby's Rainbow Farm normally sits docked along the bottom of your screen, running quietly in the background. Want it even smaller? Shrink it down into a compact mini window and tuck it into a corner — just the right size to keep an eye on things while you work.          How Your Farm Grows    1.Clear the Way, Grow Your Farm   Clear away weeds and rocks to expand your farm bit by bit. The more open ground you have, the more freedom you get to lay out fields and buildings.          2.Till the Soil, Grow Your Crops   Till, sow, water — Rabby handles the whole growing process once you give the word.          3.Meet New Faces, Unlock New Possibilities   Visitors stop by your farm now and then. Talk with them, trade with them, and new options and discoveries open up along the way.          4.Cook and Craft to Grow Closer   Cook up a meal to treat your visitors, or craft something special — every gesture deepens your bond with the people around you.          5.Earn Their Trust, Gain a Helping Hand   Once a visitor's bond with you grows deep enough, they'll start lending a hand around the farm — watering, harvesting, hauling, and more.        *The bonds you build will run deeper still in the full release — more ways for them to become part of your daily farm life.      New Features in Development    Craft Furniture to Decorate Your Farm   Freely place furniture to decorate your farm exactly how you like it. Can't find the piece you want? Craft it yourself at the workbench.          Strike it Lucky at the Mine   Beyond the fog, a quiet mine waits to be explored. Send Rabby down to dig up new resources and open up fresh possibilities for what you can build.         More characters will join over time.       *Some of the characters in this game are shared with the mobile game "Seven's Story." Fans of that title are sure to find something to enjoy here too.

about: Kitty Needs a Home!  is a warm little story about a small backyard that finds homes for cats all over the world.  Jane has flown off to save a shelter far away, and left the yard in your hands. Catch cats, upgrade the shelter, read letters — from a snowman by the ice rink to an alien with a dead-battery flying saucer — and find every whiskered friend the perfect home.  🐾  Catch them and find them homes.  Dozens of cat types — from ordinary fidgets to legendary ones woven out of pure wonder. Each has its own personality: affectionate, playful, laid-back.  💌  44 clients — 44 little stories.  Programmers, ballerinas, firefighters, rock stars, and one very lonely zombie fighter. Fulfill a request — get a postcard for your Endings Album.  🌍  Spread kindness across the world.  Level up geo-zones and send cats off to London, Tokyo, Houston, and Dubai.  🔮  Branching quests.  Strange glowing grass, a flying saucer, and letters that only arrive at night… Some stories will find you on their own.  😴  Plays while you sleep.  The shelter runs without you: hearts drip in, letters pile up. And "Catcher Mode" turns the game into a sweet little desktop companion in the corner of your screen.  ❤️  And, of course, Jane.  Every cat you find a home for brings the end of this story a little closer.

name: Machikado Roastery
lang: English, Japanese
short: Roast coffee across Japan, right from your taskbar. Run a tiny corner roastery along the bottom of your screen: roast beans, stock the display case, hire staff, and move your shop from Tokyo’s backstreets to snowy Sapporo as the seasons turn.
about: Machikado Roastery (街角ロースタリー) is a cozy idle game that lives in a thin strip along the bottom of your screen. Work, browse, or play something else - your little roastery keeps brewing, and customers keep wandering in.    A coffee shop that stays out of your way    Transparent, always-on-top window that sits above your taskbar     Click straight through empty space to whatever's behind it     Crisp pixel art at any resolution, on any monitor     Quiet by default, light on your PC, and it never punishes you for looking away            Roast it yourself  Start with a hand-held te-ami over a flame and 50 grams of green beans. Listen for first crack, drop the roast, and work your way up to a drum roaster and beyond. Fresh roasts become pour-overs, lattes, iced coffee, and coffee jelly - then stock the display case so customers can grab what they want before they lose patience.          Tour Japan  Move your roastery anywhere, any time. Each place has its own street, its own landmark on the horizon, its own local sweets, and its own regulars.     The old backstreets of Yanaka, Tokyo     Kawaguchiko, at the foot of Mt. Fuji     Nara Park, where the deer have opinions about your senbei     Higashiyama, Kyoto, under evening lanterns     Sapporo during the snow festival     ...and more, across all four seasons             Build your crew  Hire staff for the counter, the roaster, the kitchen, and the barista bar. Everyone has a role, a personality, and room to grow - mentor your favorites, and teach them traits they've picked up from more experienced hires.          Grow your Fame  Unlock new menu items one at a time, pair each origin with the right sweets, and earn a name for yourself. Get written up in the paper, catch the attention of the local TV crew, and when a celebrity walks in craving the local specialty, make sure it's in the case.          Made to leave running  No timers that expire while you're away. No energy bars. No tapping to speed things up. Check in when you feel like it - your shop will be right where you left it.   From the developer  Hi, I'm Kyle! I was born and raised in Seattle, the city of coffee. While I was growing up, my aunt and uncle were building their bakery business, and eventually they started roasting their own coffee.  I've lived in Japan for 17 years now, and this year I decided it was time to bring my family's flavor across the Pacific. I've spent the year setting up my own roastery here in Gunma.     I'm a game developer who's gone deep into coffee, so making a game about it was the obvious next step. Everything in Machikado Roastery, from the crackle of the beans to the sweets in the case, comes from roasting, tasting and living it here in Japan.

about: SideDrop is a block-breaking idle game that lives at the edge of your screen. Have it alongside anything you're doing, work, browse, game, watch and let the blocks rise and the balls fall.  Blocks spawn from the bottom and push upward. Physics-based balls fall from above to smash through them. Keep the grid from reaching the top by upgrading your firepower, unlocking automated droppers, and discovering new ball types.  Drop balls manually to target threats, or build a fully automated setup and walk away. Either way, the currency keeps flowing and the upgrades keep stacking.         Features     Screen overlay  — transparent background, resizable, repositionable, with an always-on-top option     Active or idle  — click to aim and drop balls yourself, or build an arsenal that runs on its own     Spatial upgrade tree  — a grid of upgrades expanding in every direction: damage, crit chance, ball speed, score bonuses, and more     Multiple dropper types  — auto-droppers, lasers, shotguns, mortars, snipers — each with their own upgrade branches     Special ball types  — unlock new balls, each with unique abilities     Escalating difficulty  — blocks grow tougher the deeper you go     Visual customisation  — unlock skins and adjust colours to your liking

name: Ball Buster Breakout
lang: English*, French*, Italian*, German*, Russian*, Spanish - Latin America*, Portuguese - Brazil**
short: Fire your balls into dense grids of bricks, trigger cascading chaos, and build an unstoppable engine of breakout destruction!
about: GRAB YOUR BALLS AND GET READY TO BUST!        Ball Buster Breakout is a modern brick breaker built for pure physical chaos. You load a cannon with specialized balls and fire them into grids of bricks. Watch them bounce, ricochet, stick, explode, and create massive cascading chain reactions that, after strategic upgrades, can clear the screen in seconds.  Every shattered brick drops gold. Gold buys stronger balls and deeper upgrades. What starts as a single bouncing ball quickly becomes a screen-filling storm of destruction. Clear waves, crush bosses, and keep pushing further as the grids get denser and the destruction becomes automated and more satisfying.    This is classic brick-breaking physics turned into a high-velocity idle engine. Click to help, or step back and let your growing arsenal of balls do the work while you watch the cascading destruction unfold.    Dominate your entire screen with your balls.  Ready to go from a single bouncing ball to screen-clearing devastation?    Ball Buster Breakout    is a blend of classic brick-breaking physics and idle incrementa/automation gameplay.  In this  Bullet Heaven -adjacent idle game, instead of dodging the chaos, you are automating it. Your only goal? Build an autonomous engine of destruction that blankets the screen in a flashing, high-velocity torrent of balls.     AIM! FIRE! OBLITERATE!      Purchase balls to load your cannon. Aim and fire  into a grid of bricks. Every brick you destroy earns gold. Gold buys upgrades and new ball that trigger chaotic effects. Each completed wave pushes you deeper into harder territory, including  boss encounters  that try to prevent you from busting. DO NOT let them prevent you from busting! In this game it is your unique and unalienable right to bust.     AN ARSENAL OF 15+ UNIQUE BALLS      Bombs, shotguns, lasers, replicators, demons, nukes, quakes and katanas OH MY!  Your cannon is only as powerful as what you load into it. Purchase and upgrade a wide variety of specialty balls, each with its own passive ability.      Each ball type has its own dedicated  upgrade tree . Increase blast radius, bullet spread,  damage, speed, and special effects. Mix and match your active balls to build a loadout that suits your style.     CLICK OR LET IT IDLE     You're never just waiting. Click bricks directly to deal manual damage, or step back and let your army of balls do the work? Ball Buster Breakout runs in the background and progress never stops.     Desktop Companion Mode: Overlap & Idle   Toggle  Desktop Companion  mode to transform  Ball Buster Breakout  into the ultimate secondary-screen experience.  The game draws directly over your other active windows, letting you seamlessly work, stream, or browse while the physics engine runs in the background. Watch the chaotic destruction unfold out of the corner of your eye, step in to buy game-changing upgrades, and enjoy effortless  idle progression  without ever minimizing your workflow. It’s a low-stress  casual idler  designed to live right on your active desktop.     A HYPNOTIC GLITCH BASS SOUNDTRACK   An original Glitch Bass music soundtrack built around clicks, cracks, and collisions composed by Bobi Meijer and Lucas Schwyter.     STACKABLE POWER-UPS        Destroy special treasure bricks to unlock a  rarity-tiered power-up system  (Common, Uncommon, Rare, Epic, Legendary). When a treasure chest drops, choose between randomized cards to permanently or temporarily boost your run:    Summon special overpowered balls, Unlock special gold-per-click bonuses...and dozens more effects across five rarity tiers    Power-ups are stored in a deck and stackable to create overpowered combinations       WAVES, LEVELS AND BOSS FIGHTS        Work through hand-designed  waves of bricks , each cleared wave pushing you to the next level. Special brick types keep things unpredictable:     Gold Bricks:  shatter them for bonus gold drops     Bomb Bricks:  chain-react and clear their neighbors     Deposit Bri

name: Desktop Divinity
lang: English, Simplified Chinese
short: Build a cozy idle kingdom at the bottom of your desktop. Recruit female followers, collect gold and faith, and summon goddesses. Watch your pixel companions stroll, dance, and pray while you grow your realm and upgrade its facilities.
about: A little kingdom to keep you company.   Little Divinity is a cozy desktop idle game that blends gentle companionship with light management. Along a transparent strip at the bottom of your desktop, female followers wander through the grass, clouds drift overhead, and a little shrine welcomes their prayers.  Check in for a moment, welcome a new companion, or let your realm quietly gather gold and faith while you go about your day.   Little companions, everyday moments   Watch your followers stroll, pause, and take turns praying at the shrine. Hover over them to turn your cursor into a magic wand, then click to make them dance and receive gifts of copper, silver, and gold coins.  A small interaction can become a pleasant break between tasks.   Start with three followers and grow your realm   Welcome Human Farmers, Human Soldiers, and Elf Archers, each contributing gold and faith. Spend your gold to recruit more followers and unlock additional slots, growing your starting group of three into a community of up to thirty residents.  Choose your next investment at your own pace: another companion, more room to grow, or a useful facility for your kingdom.   Offer faith and summon goddesses   Meet Freya, the Harvest Goddess; Aurelia, the Dawn Goddess; and Selene, the Moonhunt Goddess.  Gather faith to unlock their animated portraits and receive their blessings. Each goddess strengthens her corresponding follower class, increasing its gold and faith production as your little realm grows.   Build miracles on your desktop   Construct a Tax Office and choose its position on the grass. It automatically collects coin gifts from followers within its reach.  Upgrade the facility to expand its collection range, or move it to better suit your followers’ movements. A thoughtful placement makes caring for your kingdom a little easier.   A companion that fits your day   Click the shrine to open the management interface, where you can view your followers, recruit companions, summon goddesses, and build facilities.  When you want more desktop space, collapse the kingdom into a small, draggable shrine icon. Double-click it whenever you are ready to return.  With up to eight hours of offline base earnings, Japanese-inspired pixel characters, animated goddess portraits, and a gentle background soundtrack, Little Divinity brings a quiet touch of fantasy to your everyday desktop.  Supports Simplified Chinese, English, Japanese, and Korean.

name: Multiscreens
lang: English
short: A program in VR that lets you have as many virtual monitors as you want.
about:
Multiscreens is a early-access program that lets you have as many screens as you want in VR. Specifically, each program is its own screen and can be moved around as desired. 
 
Right now you can: 
 
- Change the target framerate of each window captured 
- Play multiple videos simultaneously (just make sure if you are in chrome to disable Hardware Acceleration in advanced settings) while playing a game 
- Turn on supersampling 
- Control everything with your mouse which leaves your keyboard and controller free for typical use (there is also a mouse sensitivity setting) 
- Move windows freely in a 3D space around you and make them bigger or smaller as desired 
- Capture right click menus and other context menus 
- Capture the mouse on the currently active window 
- No Headless Ghosts are required, this program works fine when you simply have a single physical monitor (or headless ghost) plugged in 
- Minimize (hide) windows as desired 
- Change focus between windows with a single click 
- Use a webcam that's displayed below you to see your keyboard while in VR 
- Multiscreens can technically capture every window, but some it can only capture while they are currently focused 
- There is a "virtual taskbar" that allows you to bring up programs you have opened by clicking on their icons below 
- You can change this Taskbar's position 
- Reset view 
 
Current limitations (in order of planned feature addition): 
 
- Screens can't be curved yet 
- You generally need to open windows before opening Multiscreens, it's difficult to start programs while in Multiscreens (I'm going to add a search bar to open any program you currently have installed and allow you to "pin" programs to your taskbar) 
- Can't capture the entire desktop 
- Vive controller support doesn't exist yet, everything is currently controlled with your mouse 
 
Enjoy, and let me know what you think! I'm happy to listen to feedback and will try and make this the best product for all of you as possible :)

name: À Deriva
lang: English, German, Spanish - Spain, Simplified Chinese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian
short: A fisherman lives on your computer's taskbar. He fishes on his own while you work, from the Araguaia to the sea off Noronha. You glance over now and then, click when one bites, and buy a bigger boat. It also runs as a wallpaper.
about: It lives on your taskbar The game opens as a thin strip above your taskbar and stays there while you use the computer. If you want more room, it becomes a wallpaper and fills the whole screen, behind your icons.         He fishes on his own You don't have to do anything. The fish bites when it feels like it and the fisherman reels the line in. If you happen to be watching when it bites, one click makes the catch better. If you're not, the fish goes into the hold anyway.         From the Araguaia to the open sea You start on the Araguaia, white beach and shallow water. Then come the Rio Negro, the flooded forest of Furnas, the coast of Santa Catarina and the sea off Fernando de Noronha, where whatever bites is usually bigger than your boat. From canoe to ocean boat Sooner or later the hold fills up before the day is over. So you sell the fish and change boats: dinghy, speedboat, trawler, up to the ocean boat that makes the canoe look like a toy. Better bait brings better fish. Rain, nightfall, thunder The weather changes by itself. Rain arrives slowly, a storm rocks the boat and cracks the sky, and on some nights the moon turns red. Each kind of weather brings a different fish.         Wildlife passing by A caiman with its eye on the hook. A giant otter that only takes the fat ones. A river dolphin pushing the shoal your way. A jaguar lying on the sand. They show up when they feel like it. A hat delivered by stork Every now and then a stork crosses the screen carrying a parcel. Click it before it passes and the hat is yours. You can put it on the fisherman or sell it on the Steam Community Market. Each one comes tattered, used or new.         A championship every month Every fish you catch scores points on a monthly leaderboard. Whoever ends the month on top gets a celestial hat, one that no stork delivers and nowhere sells. What it doesn't do No ads, no energy bar, no notification asking you to come back. And nothing you play leaves your computer.

name: Homicide Desk
lang: English*, Arabic*, Simplified Chinese, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Turkish*
short: Read the evidence. Run the forensics. Question suspects in your own words, they lie, crack, or lawyer up. Accuse the wrong person, and Internal Affairs comes after you.
about: In Homicide Desk you work a homicide the way a real detective's desk works: a case file lands, a short list of suspects, and a screen full of tools. No waypoints, no glowing clues, no cutscenes telling you what to think. Read the evidence, run the lab, and question your suspects in your own words — then decide who you're willing to charge.  Get it right and the case closes. Get it wrong and Internal Affairs opens a file on you.                 There is no dialogue tree. Type whatever you want and your suspect answers back in natural, conversational language — deflecting, rationalizing, contradicting themselves. Slide a document across the table and watch their stress meter spike. Push too hard on nothing and they lawyer up and walk. Corner them with the right evidence and the story finally cracks.               Everything lives on the desktop, and you have to actually use it:    Case files — dig through nested folders of reports, statements and photos.    Forensics lab — you don't click "analyze." You align the fingerprint, break the cipher, and calibrate the chromatograph yourself, against the clock.    phone records & photo evidence — flag the timestamp, cross-reference the calls, drag the UV light across the print.    Locked & sealed documents — some files won't open until you've earned the code or unsealed them in interrogation.           One city. Ravenport.  A rain-soaked, fictional port city in the Republic of Meridia, rendered as a CRT-era police OS — scanlines, a working world clock, weather on the taskbar, and a case that pushes back in real time with pressure emails and a mid-case twist.             Features     Free-text suspect interrogations that respond to your questions and your evidence    Hands-on forensics, phone-record and photo-analysis puzzles    A physical evidence board with string connections and a case-chain tracker    Written deductions with real consequences for a wrong arrest    Multiple guilty-party variants — reopen a solved case and the truth changes    A living precinct: salary economy, patrol dispatch, commissary, side games    Fully playable in  English and Arabic , with full right-to-left support      The case is open, Detective. The desk is yours.

name: Unread
lang: English**
short: Explore a simulated 1990s computer left running by someone who never came back. Search its files, uncover hidden games, and piece together their story.
about: Somebody left their computer on   Unread starts in front of an old CRT monitor, running an operating system that echoes from decades ago.  A Simulated Computer  Boot into a fake DOS prompt before dropping into a Windows 95-style desktop, complete with a file system, taskbar, Recycle Bin, Control Panel, and all the familiar little frustrations of a real operating system.  Nothing is just decoration. Every folder opens. Every program runs. Even the CRT effect can be switched off from inside the game if you'd rather see everything clearly (try Accessibility Options).  A Story You Have to Go Looking For  Nobody explains what happened.  The story is scattered across files, emails, logs, and whatever the previous user left behind. Read things in any order you like. Piece enough together and a picture starts to emerge.  More Than Files  Not everything on this machine is a document. Some of what's buried in the file system turns out to be something else entirely. Finding it is part of the experience.  Set the Tone Yourself  This isn't a jump-scare game. In fact it's more of a digital toybox than a traditional game, something to pick up and play with for a while. It's slower and quieter,  more interested in what someone left behind than in making you flinch. Take it at your own pace, you're finished when you're satisfied.  Features    Explore a simulated PC with a DOS prompt and Windows 95-style desktop    Piece together the story through emails, documents, audio recordings, and other files    Several hidden games in different genres, discoverable by actually poking around    A toggleable CRT screen effect, on by default, off if you'd rather not    Steam Achievements tied to things you'll only find by exploring

Before long, there's a cozy nest perched on your browser window and a bridge leading to the next one.  Woollings is a cozy desktop companion with a tiny flock and surprisingly big plans. While you work, study, or browse, your sheep explore, make friends, and turn familiar windows into a world of their own.       Your windows are their world  The flock lives right on your actual application windows, hopping between edges and finding clever routes across your desktop. Move, open, or close a window, and their little world changes with it.  Sometimes they find a sensible path. Sometimes they just climb on top of each other.  A civilization that grows with the flock  As the sheep settle in, loose tufts of wool turn into snug nests and curious contraptions. Bridges link neighboring windows, pulley lifts reach higher ledges, and balloon platforms open up brand-new routes.  Buildings appear naturally as the flock's needs grow. Leave the details to them, focus on your work, and look back to find they might already have built an elevator.       Discover 20 kinds of sheep  Meet fluffy regulars, ghostly visitors, mechanical oddballs, and gleaming golden sheep. Get to know their personalities, friendships, and favorite spots, then dress your favorites in cute accessories so you can spot them at a glance. RiderOS — The Desktop Is the Game   Neon Arcade isn't a list of titles in a boring launcher. It's an operating system. name: INKLINE: Erased Lines
lang: English, French, German, Spanish - Latin America, Traditional Chinese, Korean, Russian, Turkish, Japanese, Kazakh, Kyrgyz, Tajik, Uzbek, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Simplified Chinese, Hindi
short: Your desktop is more than a screen — a world waiting to be drawn. Sketch bridges, raise walls and set traps with your mouse in this hand-drawn action platformer. Battle ink-born monsters, explore chapters and face bosses as an adventure comes alive above your taskbar.
about: INKLINE: Erased Lines is a hand-drawn 2D action platformer that lives right on your desktop. The game runs in a transparent strip above the Windows taskbar, so the adventure can continue alongside your browser, editor, or other programs.              If the path ends — draw a new one.   Drawing is a full part of INKLINE's gameplay. Create bridges, defensive walls, and traps, and when you reach especially large gaps, open your sketchbook and create vehicles based on a reference.  A plane, catapult, hot-air balloon, or another means of transportation can help you reach places that are impossible to cross with a normal jump. The more accurately you reproduce the drawing, the more reliable the result will be.              Small hero. Big weapon.   Combine normal and powerful attacks, use dashes, strike after jumping, slam into the ground, and unleash ink abilities against entire groups of enemies.  Different types of enemies stand in your way, from fast attacking creatures to heavier opponents with their own behavior patterns. At the end of each chapter, bosses await, capable of changing the course of the fight as the battle progresses.              One journey — ten different chapters.   The journey begins in the Flower Meadow, but gradually takes the hero farther and farther away from the peaceful beginning of the adventure.  Ink Harbor, Enchanted Forest, Stone Canyon, Clockwork Workshop, Pagoda Peaks, Ink Swamp, Sandy Desert, Snowy Mountains, and other chapters gradually lead toward the Ink Castle.  Each new chapter changes the environment, atmosphere, enemies, and challenges, and ends with its own boss battle.              Don't miss the moment when everything is ready.   INKLINE can stay by your side while you work on other things. Enable notifications, and the game can let you know when compilation or another background task finishes, when Claude or Codex responds, or when a new event appears from a supported application.  The notification appears directly on your desktop, so you don't have to constantly switch between windows and check whether the task is finished.              Some bosses have no intention of staying inside the game strip.   During special attacks, the battle visually breaks beyond the boundaries of INKLINE. Your desktop may begin to shake, cracks spread across the screen, and ink and other effects appear over the familiar space of your computer.  For a few moments, it may feel as if the boss has actually reached your desktop.

about: The hero fights on his own — and slacks off on his own  Inside a small window parked in the corner of your desktop, your hero fights automatically (and reluctantly). All you have to do is watch. There is just one problem: he is lazy.    When his motivation runs out, he climbs out of the battle screen and starts slacking off on your desktop. He sits on the windows you have open, wanders along your taskbar, and falls asleep right there. He will not get in the way of your work — but the game will not get anywhere either.  A by-the-book RPG  Underneath all of that, this is a properly traditional RPG. You get classic turn-based RPG battles, exactly the way you remember them. Fight, Run, Magic, Defend — put the commands to work and climb the tower. There are herbs, too, naturally. You can buy gear, and you will find some along the way. Just remember that weapons and armor do nothing at all until you actually equip them.  The hero's party is a party of three, and you are free to build it however you like. That is the classic way, after all.  Step in now and then and things go a little smoother  There are no clicking contests here and no daily chores. Play it as a normal RPG, or just leave it running. Still, when your hero is off slacking, you should probably go collect him once in a while. He is supposed to be the hero, after all.  Even his slacking gets you a little something.       Sleep:  HP and motivation come back, and he sometimes returns with a buff.     Scavenge:  He forgets the battle entirely and wanders your desktop. He might come back with pocket change or a consumable.     Get hauled back by a party member:  The hero returns to battle on his own, but expect some unnecessary chatter on the way.    Retreat and get stronger!  Aim for the 100th floor of the Demon Tower. In this world, thanks to assorted blessings, heroes simply do not die. They do not die — but the enemies keep getting stronger. Once you cannot climb any higher, retreat and head back to the tavern in town. The princess may get cross about it, but going home pays. Spend the mana you earned in battle to power your hero up, then go for the 100th floor again. Collect enough abilities and the adventure keeps getting easier.  Rescue the princess with some dependable companions    A cleric who lectures, a mage with no MP discipline, a thief who opens chests uninvited. Adventure with the party members every RPG has.    Boots of Running Away, a Legendary-ish Sword, a Cursed Helmet that is not actually cursed. Plenty of gear whose descriptions you should not trust.    A weapon shop licensed by the Demon Army, an inn with a branch on every floor, a treasure chest parked somewhere suspiciously convenient. All the classics.      A game that stays resident on your desktop    You can enjoy this game while you get on with your work on the same PC.    When things get dicey, tuck it into the system tray. Show/hide and mute are there to help, too.    Please do not play it while you are on the clock.    While you are studying, though — that is probably fine.

name: 777 HERO ~The One Who Defies Time~
lang: English, Japanese, Korean, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese
short: 777 HERO is a pixel-art idle RPG that captures all the heart-pounding moments of pachinko! And of course! It's built so that even people who know nothing about pachinko can have plenty of fun, so don't worry! The controls are super simple too!
about: - Your hands rest, your dopamine works overtime!!     777 HERO is a pixel-art idle RPG that captures all the heart-pounding moments of pachinko!    And of course! It's built so that even people who know nothing about pachinko can have plenty of fun, so don't worry!    The controls are super simple too! There's absolutely no real-money gambling, and the only currency you'll ever spend is! The Souls you earn in the game!           - Simple controls!! Just leave it running until you hit the jackpot!!    Turn on Auto-fire and the balls launch all by themselves. Keep the window small and go do something else.    When you win, just hold down the Space bar. The Hero takes care of the rest. Easy controls!!!    Alert Mode: turns the music off and lets you know only when something good happens, with a sound and a flashing taskbar icon.    Mini Mode: keep a tiny screen tucked in the corner of your monitor and enjoy the true taste of an idle game!    Auto-saves whenever you quit. You can even quit in the middle of a RUSH and pick up right where you left off.              - All the flavor of pachinko, none of the gambling!!    If you hit the jackpot and the game congratulates you with a shrug, that's no fun at all, right..? So I've prepared all kinds of fun presentations!    Every draw is a fully independent roll with no hidden correction! The "Draws" counter even shows you, in hard data, just how unlucky your current losing streak is!              - But just leaving it running all the time gets boring, right!!    777 HERO isn't just a game where you wait around for the next draw! Pick your own win bonuses and power up your character!    Win in a row during RUSH mode and you get even more chances to choose!              - Win RUSH in a row, or hit 777, and a huge chance appears?!    Every few wins, a Jackpot Time begins where all kinds of rewards come pouring down! A chance to power up your character big time!!    Whatever lands in a hole is yours!! With a little luck, you can even get a high-rarity Gear Selection Box!              - Hit it and stuff explodes!!    Just swinging a sword would be boring! In this game, attacking a boss has a chance to set off all sorts of stuff!    There are many different ways to attack. Take on the bosses with special gear and skill combos!              - Skill nodes bursting with personality!! 59 nodes in total! Conquer the game with your very own build!!    Skills that only bump up numbers felt boring, so I made special skills instead!    Each direction on the tree pursues a different play style! Research your very own build!    Resetting your skills is pretty cheap. So it's totally fine if you pick the wrong one by mistake!              - Boxes get opened with a kick!! If an aura shows up, is it a high-rarity chance?!    Collect gear and relics full of personality!    128 kinds of gear and 37 relics are waiting for you!              - Got a good weapon? Then you've gotta enhance it!    Content that will pump out endless dopamine! Weapon Enhancement is here!    For balance reasons, only weapons can be enhanced for now! Gotta show the bosses a little mercy too..    Weapon Enhancement unlocks after you've progressed a bit into the game!             - Clear hidden achievements for generous rewards and skill points!  They even give you permanent effects?!    239 achievements are waiting for you! (They'll be updated up to 333!) — Most of the conditions are secret!    11 Title ranks — earn titles with permanent effects based on how many achievements you've completed!           The Story  Two years ago, my older sister left home and never came back. One million sword drills, zero real combat experience..... A timid twenty-year-old swordswoman sets out on a journey carrying nothing but the pocket watch her sister gave her.  But... what's this? The watch starts talking to her. It turns out a goddess with the power to stop time was living inside that watch, and she nags. A LOT.... Ugh... Where

name: Wallpaper
lang: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Arabic, Bulgarian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Finnish, Greek, Hungarian, Indonesian, Japanese, Korean, Malay, Norwegian, Polish, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Romanian, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Thai, Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian, Vietnamese
short: 700+ live wallpapers that read your real machine: the GPU heats up and the sky reddens, music moves the water. Anime scenes, desktop pets and a Steam Workshop full of community creations — or build your own in HTML, CSS and JavaScript, even with AI.
about: Your desktop, alive — and aware of your machine  Wallpaper turns your Windows desktop into a living surface. Not a video on loop: these are scenes that read your hardware in real time. Your graphics card heats up and the sky reddens. Your music plays and the ocean moves with it. Snow falls and settles on your real desktop icons. There are animated anime scenes and studio-grade 3D effects too — and a 3D desktop pet of your own that walks along your taskbar. 700+ wallpapers, 17 categories    Anime  — hand-picked animated anime scenes: cozy rooms, rain, festivals and fantasy worlds; seamless loops with optional ambient sound    Cinematic  — studio-grade 3D effects: ray-traced liquids, chrome, glass and physics    Fractal  — endless mathematical patterns, Julia/Mandelbrot, orbit traps    Visualization  — flowing music visualisation patterns, hundreds to choose from    Playground  — scenes you can touch with the mouse that live on their own    Desktop-Aware  — scenes that read the real icons and windows on your desktop    HTML Boards  — single-file scenes; text, colour and layout change from the right panel    3D Scene  — three.js scenes, glTF models, real depth    Particles & Flow  — flocking, fluids, gravity, cursor interaction    Shader  — raw GLSL scenes, raymarching, procedural textures    Scene & Landscape  — sky, ocean, mountains, day cycle    Minimal & Clock  — clean typography, clocks, single-colour compositions    Audio & Spectrum  — visualisers that live with music: spectrum, waveform    Data Dashboard  — CPU, GPU, RAM, disk and network on your desktop    Retro  — CRT, VHS, 90s screensavers    Images  — your own photos    Video  — your own videos   Steam Workshop The official collection lives in the Steam Workshop, next to wallpapers, images, videos and desktop pets made by the community. Subscribe with one click and it shows up in the app.   Filters for topic, resolution and aspect ratio, and a search that turns topic names in your language into filters   Share your own wallpapers and pets with the built-in share wizard   See which public wallpapers your Steam friends are using right now (you can turn this off)   Age ratings: Everyone, Questionable and Mature — Questionable and Mature stay hidden until you turn them on (18+)   A 3D desktop pet of your own On the  Pet  page you create your own 3D anime companion — and then she steps out onto your desktop.   Walks along the taskbar, jumps up onto windows, sits on their edges and rides along when you drag them   Roams across all of your monitors, leaping from one screen to the next   Chases your cursor, dances when music plays and startles at sudden sounds   Gets tired over time: yawns, rubs her eyes and finally curls up for a nap   Pick her up and drop her anywhere; click her for little reactions   Hides automatically while a full-screen game or video is running   Pet Studio  gives you 200+ options: hairstyles, eye styles, makeup, tops, bottoms, dresses, shoes, socks, gloves, headwear, neck accessories and fabric patterns. The  Random  button picks outfits that actually match, and 4 personalities — Cheerful, Shy, Sleepy and Mischievous — each behave differently.  In the pet settings you choose the frame rate and image quality, switch each behavior on or off and see live resource usage. Turn the pet off and it uses no resources at all. Four themes, three anime guides In  Settings  ›  APPEARANCE  you choose the world the app lives in:  Sakura Garden ,  City Nights ,  Star Observatory  or  Classic . In the first three, a live scene plays across the top of the library and an anime guide — HANA, LUMI or ASTRA — shows you how to apply a wallpaper and cheers when you do. Quick buttons next to her pick a surprise for you, open the anime shelf or find something calm. You can hide the guide and keep just the live scene. Classic keeps the original, quieter look. The app works the same in every theme; only the look changes. It reacts to your machine This is the part
